Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Looks like our gals are brewing up something back there. I'd be afraid if I were you.", 'They say you come from the ruins. Hehehe ... The Aurochs gotta be desperate to depend on some wacko.', "We thought you'd be a pushover. You Aurochs have sure improved!", 'Another tournament, another victory ... But no parade, thanks to those fiends.', "I'm grateful that the warrior monks are here to protect Luca, but aren't there a few too many?", 'Rumor has it that you guys are traitors. Some people sure talk rubbish.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['We swore victory on our horns and lost. We cannot go home until we win the cup.', "Ronso are pious race. But still, we respect Crusaders' courage.", 'If Ronso Fangs win, our brothers on the Farplane will rejoice.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Since embracing Yevon, we Guado have learned the joy that is blitzball.', 'I hope that the people of Spira will find peace through blitzball.', "I want to congratulate Lord Seymour on his marriage by blitzing like nobody's blitzed before.", 'Guadosalam is a natural stronghold. No fiends will find their way in here.', "Lord Seymour's aeon destroyed the fiends that appeared in Luca Stadium. That display of Lord Seymour's raw power struck me speechless. But it was all a show. I feel so ... I'm sorry. I cannot put it into words."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Look!', 'Take it.', 'A gift from Jecht.', 'I hope you know how to use it.', "These ones don't matter. We cut through!", "Don't bother going after all of them. Cut the ones that matter, and run!", "Some can't wait to die!", "We're expected.", 'Hmph. This could be bad.', "Trust me. You'll see.", 'Go!', '(Looks at Sin) You are sure?', 'This is it. This is your story. It all begins here.', 'It was a bad call. Your team lost because of you.', "It's been ... ten years. I thought you'd be crying.", 'Yeah.', "That's correct.", 'Nothing impossible about it. Jecht, Braska and I ... Together we defeated Sin ten years ago. Then I went to Zanarkand ... where I watched over you. So that one day I could bring you to Spira.', 'Jecht asked me to.', 'It depends on what you mean by "alive." He is no longer human. But then ... I felt something of Jecht, there in that shell ... couldn\'t you? You must have felt him when you came in contact with Sin.', 'It is. Sin is Jecht.', "But it is the truth. You'll see for yourself. Come with me.", 'Every story must have an ending.', "(Unsympathetically) I see. Sorry you feel that way. Fine, then. Come or don't come. It's your decision.", 'Irritating, I know. Or are you afraid?', "(Sets a hand on his shoulder, speaks more gently) It's all right.", "That's up to Jecht.", "I'm going to offer my services to Yuna. Come.", 'Yuna.', 'I wish to become your guardian. Do you accept?', 'You refuse?', 'I promised Braska.', 'This one I promised Jecht.', "Can't say. Haven't seen him in ten years.", "You'll meet eventually.", "(Scans them, zeroes in on Lulu) What's our itinerary? Where are we headed?", "Remember, you're suffering from Sin's toxin. Don't say otherwise.", "It's also tough. Let me handle this.", 'Why?', "Let them use whatever they want. They still won't defeat Sin.", 'We rest here.', 'Is that a problem?', 'Where were her guardians?', 'Well I am.', 'She means the ruins of a city destroyed a thousand years ago.', "You'll see it for yourself soon enough.", 'Yuna, come back inside.', "That's our cue, let's go.", "So, we're to be pushed off a cliff.", 'Attack now! Push it back!', '(Dryly) Now I know I can count on you.', "It was your idea to fight that thing. If you're always so groggy, just stay awake.", 'Ask him yourself.', 'Let him go. The man has already chosen his path ... As you did when you became a summoner.', 'If you want to prove yourself ...', 'first you must complete the tasks you are given.', '...', "We don't have time for this now, do we?", '(Mutters) That Kinoc, a maester?', 'Fulfilling a promise I made to a friend. I still am.', 'Go to Yuna.', "You won't have to. It'll come.", 'So the arms are for defense.', "It's going to attack. Aim for the head!", 'Look out!', "(Standing nearby) I see you're still here.", 'Many stories ended here today ... But ...', 'Yours goes on, I see.', 'A swift retreat. Satisfied?', 'Those who turned from Yevon died, while the faithful live on.', 'Sin is Jecht.', 'Sin is Jecht. He came here for you.', "That's what Sin does. He wanted to show that to you. Do you know why?", 'So you would kill him. As long as he is Sin, Jecht will keep killing. He wants you to stop him.', "You're the one running.", 'Hey, new guy.', 'Who else?', "Don't tell Yuna you know about Sin and Jecht.", 'You know her ... She would ... distance herself from you. We do not want that.', 'Yuna would.', 'Better than you finding out at a critical moment, becoming emotional.', '(Chuckles) I heard you were quite the crybaby.', "So you're a champion of Yevon now, Braska?", 'Stop pacing around. Be calm, and wait.', 'What of it?', 'Get ready for the journey ahead.', 'Once Lady Yuna fixes her hair, we leave!', 'Zzzz ...', "They aren't just disappearing into thin air.", "We're not waiting till nightfall.", 'Ten years ago ...', 'Jecht saw his first shoopuf here. Surprised, he drew his blade and struck it.', 'He was drunk ... Thought it was a fiend.', "We offered all the money we had as an apology. Jecht never drank again. But, it would seem that shoopuf still works here. Even after ten years, Spira hasn't changed. Truly ... The place seems to resist change. It would take something unusual. Don't let the peaceful scenery fool you. Be on guard at all times.", '(To Yuna) Sit down!', 'Yuna!', 'Guard Yuna.', '( Strides over to Rikku) Show me your face. Look at me.', 'Open your eyes.', 'As I thought.', 'Are you certain?', 'If Yuna wishes it.', 'Stay close to Yuna.', 'Stay on your guard.', 'Those with power use that power. Maesters have power.', '(Dark chuckle) I lived a long time in Zanarkand.', 'What is taking them so long?', 'Please, keep this short. Yuna must rush.', 'You know what Yuna must do.', "Spira is no playhouse. A moment's diversion may amuse an audience, but it changes nothing.", 'We will do so, then.', 'We leave.', 'Like Braska before you.', 'I do not belong there.', 'Searching the past to find the future ... This is all that is there. I need it not.', "You'd better be going.", "You're still here?", 'Is she all right?', "If she dies, I wouldn't know what to do.", 'I apologize.', 'He does not belong here.', 'Yuna, send him.', '(Gets up, sounds ragged) Talk later. We leave now.', 'It means he died an unclean death.', "Yuna! Jyscal is the Guado's problem, not yours.", "We leave as soon as Yuna returns. I trust you'll be ready.", 'Yuna, what is it?', "Hmm ... You're a poor liar.", 'Nice knowing you.', 'This storm never stops. Better to cross quickly.', "Fine, we rest. She's worse than the storm.", "(Chuckles) It's not easy being a guardian to one so young. This is going to be some journey.", 'Yes, I should thank you.', "I'd rather ... drop that subject, Rin.", "Don't tell me you were hoping it would.", '(Turns towards nearby shelter) Over there.', "That's not good enough.", 'Show me.', '(Turns away) As you wish.', 'Just one thing.', 'Then it is ... fine.', "No, I'm not. As long as she is willing to face Sin ... all else is her concern. That is a summoner's privilege. As long as she journeys.", "Next, we're going to Macalania Temple. Yuna can talk with Seymour there. We guardians will wait until they're done, and plan our next move. Understood?", "You're worried about Yuna.", 'The simplest answer would be ... in exchange for agreeing to marry him ... she hopes to negotiate with Seymour.', 'I wonder.', "(Chuckles) She's strong, but Seymour is the better negotiator.", 'Yuna wants it this way.', "On the contrary ... She doesn't want us caught up in whatever it is that she's planning.", "That's the way she is. She's naive, serious to a fault, and doesn't ask for help.", "Yuna's easy to read.", 'But hard to guard. Stand by her, always.', 'Calm down.', 'Running around in a panic is not going to help. Right now, you have to keep cool, and search.', 'Guard your emotions, then guard your summoner.', 'Shall we search?', 'Wait. It is here ... somewhere.', 'Something you should see.', "It won't take long.", "This is what spheres are made of. It absorbs and preserves people's memories.", 'Fiends are also attracted to these places.', 'Jecht left it here ten years ago. (All gasp) Play it back.', 'What are you taking?', 'This is no pleasure cruise!', 'Jecht ...', "Lord Braska ... We shouldn't be wasting our time like this!", '(Growl) Let me tell you what the hurry is!', 'He was serious. Jecht had already accepted his fate.', "Jecht ... He ... He was always talking about going home, to Zanarkand. That's why he took all those pictures–to show them to you when he returned. But as he journeyed with us and came to understand Spira, and Braska's resolve ... It happened gradually, but Jecht changed. He decided he would join Braska in his fight against Sin.", 'That was his decision.', 'Wait.', 'Jecht loved you.', "He just didn't know how to express it, he said.", 'I just thought you should know.', 'Anything can happen.', 'There is a saying "Hurry up and wait." It means, prepare quickly so you\'re ready for whatever comes next.', '(Irritably) Forgive me.', "We're all with you. Do as you will.", '(To Tidus) Sorry.', 'That was your line.', 'Stand backt.', 'Rikku!', 'Will this move?', 'Let him go. Give him time to think.', 'What?', "Hmph. Just don't do anything rash.", "I'm saying you should not complicate matters. Or you'll find yourself trapped, understand?", 'Make mistakes.', "That's what youth is for after all. Do not waste it.", 'She is a guardian.', "And that's all one needs to be a guardian.", 'This may well answer a few questions.', 'Wonderful.', 'Without us, no.', "Kimahri's up ahead. Go.", '(To Wakka) We will protect Yuna from anyone. Even a maester.', 'You killed him.', 'Yuna. Send him.', "It won't be that easy. Let's get out of here.", 'Give us a chance to explain.', 'Meaning ... ?', '(Dashes back) Where are you going? This way! Hurry up!', 'What now, I wonder.', 'A lecture?', "You should place trust in your friends. But you can't expect someone to protect you all the time. You would do well to remember that.", "It's advice.", 'Young summoners are magnets for trouble. The Hymn, hmm ...', 'Enough. Dwelling in the past is futile.', 'You want to waste time listening to her regrets?', "Our immediate concern is Yuna's pilgrimage. Are you willing to go on?", 'The fayth are the ones that give power to the summoners. Not the temples or the teachings. If the temples try to stop us ... then we will defy Yevon if we must.', 'So it is decided.', 'I am the troublemaker, after all.', 'I never asked you to follow me.', 'Jecht used to sing this song ...', 'Another trait you share.', 'Your singing reminded me of Spira.', 'Maybe.', '...', 'We should get moving soon.', 'The ground!', 'Need some help?', "(Arrives) Hmph. Let's go.", "Where's Yuna?", 'The price for protecting summoners.', "Whether Yuna's safe or not, there's trouble brewing.", 'After rescuing Yuna, then what? You want to keep her safe, correct? Would you seek to stop her pilgrimage?', 'Even against her will?', 'You are the captain.', 'Let him say what he wants.', 'He is dead. As dead as Jyscal was. His attachment to this world kept him from the next.', 'Yuna must be trying to send him.', "Perhaps he won't expect it.", "Bevelle ... It's been ten years.", "Huh, now there's a rare sight.", 'The red carpet has teeth.', 'The ferryman asks a high price.', 'Open the hatch. We fight.', 'Many summoners stray from their path and lose their way here.', 'What of Bevelle?', 'Convenient. Getting around will be easier with Yevon in disarray.', 'Messy.', 'Yevon. Mika and Seymour are not of one mind. Remember what Seymour said last we met. I do not think Mika will concur. If Yevon founders, so will Spira.', 'With no fayth, summoners cannot train. Without training, they cannot call the Final Aeon. Without the Final Aeon, they cannot defeat Sin. That is why.', 'But still, you guard Gagazet as a Ronso, not a maester. Yuna is much the same.', 'It is as I thought.', 'Yevon is in turmoil. Mika tries to keep it whole, but it crumbles around him.', 'Because you are not of this world. To those who truly believe in the teachings ... a time of much pain is coming.', 'Ten years ago, I looked up at Gagazet from where we stand now.', 'I do not remember. All I could think of was how ... how I might keep Braska alive.', 'Your duties as guardian will soon end.', 'Lies. Forget them.', "We're leaving.", "We'll learn when we arrive. Soon.", 'Look not to others for knowledge. This is your journey, too.', "They'll be upon us soon. She has sent fiends to test our summoner's strength.", 'Yunalesca.', 'In Zanarkand, she awaits the arrival of the strongest.', 'As much as Mika and Seymour.', 'Lost your nerve?', 'Braska would be proud.', 'It comes!', 'No need. We reach the summit soon.', 'You remind me of myself. Before, the closer I came to Zanarkand, the more I wondered ... when we arrive, Braska will call the Final Aeon ... He will fight Sin, then die. I thought my mind was made up long before. But when I stood here, my resolve wavered.', '(Snort) Legendary guardian? I was just a boy. A boy about your age, actually. I wanted to change the world, too. But I changed nothing. That is my story.', 'Close enough.', 'Our predecessors.', "This dome is filled with pyreflies. It's like one gigantic sphere. People's thoughts remain here. Forever.", "Well, I haven't! Lord Braska, let us go back! I don't want to see you ... die!", 'Yes, but I ... I cannot accept it.', "Yuna ... We're here.", 'Go.', 'Yes.', 'If I had told you the truth, would that really have stopped you from coming?', 'It is not too late! Let us turn back!', 'But ... my lord, there must be another way!', "Don't do this, Jecht! If you live ... there may be another way! We'll think of something, I know!", 'Lord Braska! Jecht!', 'Sin always comes back. It comes back after the Calm every time! The cycle will continue and your deaths will mean nothing!', 'You ... have a plan?', 'And the cycle went on.', "No! Where is the sense in all this? Braska believed in Yevon's teachings and died for them! Jecht believed in Braska and gave his life for him!", 'Now! This is it! Now is the time to choose! Die and be free of pain or live and fight your sorrow! Now is the time to shape your stories! Your fate is in your hands!', 'We must talk.', 'There is something you should know.', 'I am also an unsent. You are not surprised?', "When Braska and Jecht died defeating Sin ... I just couldn't accept it. I came back here ... tried to avenge them. But she struck me down. Somehow I made my way, crawling, down Mount Gagazet. But my strength left me just outside Bevelle. That's where Kimahri found me. I told him about Yuna ... just before I died. I've been wandering ever since, never going to the Farplane.", "Don't make that face. Being dead has its advantages. I was able to ride Sin and go to your Zanarkand.", 'It is one of those things that is difficult to explain. Very well, I will show you. My memories.', 'Out with it!', 'But how am I supposed to go to Zanarkand?', "All right, I will! I give you my word. I'll take care of your son. I'll guard him with my life.", '(Resolidifying) That is why.', 'Well? Any good ideas?', 'What do we know ... Sin is Jecht. Thus, you have a link ... a bond with Sin. That may be our key.', 'Rush this and we lose everything. We need to plan carefully.', "Let's see what Mika does now.", 'My lord?', 'You have my word. I will bring her here.', 'Back the way we came. Then we go north from Bevelle and climb Mt. Gagazet.', 'So the legends say. No one knows for sure. It still could be your Zanarkand.', "Yeah. But I don't understand why you wanted me to. Didn't you say you have blitzball in your Zanarkand?", 'I told you this was a waste of time.', "I guess you're right.", 'Right!', 'Thanks for everything, Kinoc.', "That, I will. And you'll be busy, too. I heard they made you second-in-command.", 'You make it sound as if I was going to die or something. I will see you again.', 'Well, then ...', 'Mm. (Nods) Farewell.', "So you don't do anything stupid again. I can't believe you attacked that shoopuf. Lord Braska had to pay the handler for damages from his own travel money.", "Ah, a promise? Which you'll forget come tomorrow!", "That's on the record.", 'Scared?', "That was not Omega. Just a shadow, born from Omega's wrath.", 'It seems we rate his personal attention, now.', 'Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living.', 'Send her.', 'Short on believers?', "Simple. Yuna has become Mika's only hope.", 'Summoners and guardians will be sacrificed for the Final Summoning no more!', 'The grand maester, running away?', "He's not here yet. How long must we wait?", 'Hmph. I see.', "I must admit I was worried at the beginning, but you've done well. One more trial to pass. Our stories will end together. Don't keep Jecht waiting. He never was a patient man.", 'Foolhardy ... But a fun plan.', "This isn't over. Not yet.", "Jecht ... He's waiting for you.", 'My story must end as well.', 'We must go to him.', "I'd like to meet Jecht before he fades away. When this is over, I will leave. I have played at life too long. Ten years ago ... I honored Jecht's last words, and travelled to Zanarkand. I planned to stay there, watching over you. But when Sin attacked Zanarkand that day, I changed my mind. Outside the dream world, life can be harsh—even cruel. But it is life. He wanted you to have a shot at life. I saw it in Sin's eyes. That's why I brought you here, to Spira.", 'I know.', "Don't stop.", "It's all right.", "It's been long enough.", 'This is your world now.', 'Scared?', "That was not Omega. Just a shadow, born from Omega's wrath.", 'It seems we rate his personal attention, now.', 'Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living.', 'Send her.', "Hmph! Let's go.", '(Trots into view) Watch your tongue, knave.', 'But I must protest ... This drunkard a guardian?', 'Braska, sir ...', 'Thanks for everything, Kinoc.', "That, I will. And you'll be busy, too. I heard they made you second-in-command.", 'You make it sound as if I was going to die or something. I will see you again.', 'Well, then ...', 'Mm. (Nods) Farewell.', 'What are you taking?', 'This is no pleasure cruise!', 'Jecht ...', "Lord Braska ... We shouldn't be wasting our time like this!", '(Growl) Let me tell you what the hurry is!', "Yeah. But I don't understand why you wanted me to. Didn't you say you have blitzball in your Zanarkand?", 'I told you this was a waste of time.', "I guess you're right.", 'Right!', "So you don't do anything stupid again. I can't believe you attacked that shoopuf. Lord Braska had to pay the handler for damages from his own travel money.", "Ah, a promise? Which you'll forget come tomorrow!", "That's on the record.", '(Irritated) Why am I doing this?', 'What do you see there, my lord?', "Now there's a scene for posterity!", 'Back the way we came. Then we go north from Bevelle and climb Mt. Gagazet.', 'So the legends say. No one knows for sure. It still could be your Zanarkand.', 'My lord?', 'You have my word. I will bring her here.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["My, you're kinda cute, too. Wanna have some fun?", 'What? You want to hang out with us? Hmm ... Maybe later.', 'How could we lose to the Aurochs, of all teams? This is a disgrace!', "Had enough? Come back when you're a man.", 'So many warrior monks watch the games. Have they no sense of duty?', "What in Spira's name is the temple thinking these days?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['You are ... Auron, no?', "Can ... I shake your hand? Auron–no, Sir Auron. You're the reason I became a guardian!", 'Thank you, sir! This means so much to me!', "I swear, I'll never wash this hand again!", 'I met Sir Auron! THE Sir Auron!', 'Hey! You, have you seen Dona?', "We got separated on the way here. Damn it all! I've got to find her!", 'But, if anything happens to her ...', "You're right."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Best of luck to the Besaid Aurochs. The Ronso Fangs will be waiting.', 'The Ronso Fangs grow stronger each day. One day, we will beat the Luca Goers.', 'Ronso shed no tear when brothers die. Pain and sorrow will never conquer mighty Ronso spirit.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Ah, a summoner party.', 'My name is Belgemine. You are ... ?', "Ah, the high summoner's daughter. I've heard much of you. But you are still fresh on the road, are you not?", 'I might have a few things to teach you.', 'Let us see which are stronger. My aeons or yours. A one-on-one match. Not to the death, of course. What do you say?', "Well, it's your decision.", 'Tell me if you change your mind. Have you changed your mind? You wish to train?', "Good. Before we begin ... (Sparkle) Your aeons have been healed. You can fight with your full strength. Come. (Summons Ifrit) Show me how strong of a link you've forged with your aeons.", 'Stop. That is enough.', "Not bad for one so young. I underestimated you. Take this. You've earned it.", 'You need more training. But you did well.', 'You show promise. With more training, you could defeat Sin.', 'I cannot.', 'Or should I say ... I was not able to.', 'We meet again.', "I heard you took part in Operation Mi'ihen. You've seen that machina aren't the answer. In the end, only summoners can hope to defeat Sin.", 'I can help with that, if you like. I propose a contest of aeons. A friendly contest, of course.', "As you wish. A pity, though. I'm ready anytime, if you change your mind.", "That's the spirit! But before we begin ... (sparkle) I have healed your aeons. Well, shall we? (Summons Ixion) Call whichever aeon you want.", "Don't hold anything back! Show me what you've learned.", 'Stop. That is enough.', "You're good. You bested me fairly. Here, your prize. Go on, take it.", 'You have a lot to learn.', 'Still wet behind the ears, but you have spirit. Here, your prize. Go on, take it.', 'Study, Yuna, and grow strong.', "Oh, you again. You're quite the notorious traitor these days.", "(Chuckles) Ah, you shouldn't take what the maesters say too seriously. For summoners, destroying Sin is everything. We are no tools of Yevon, understand?", 'So, are you up to the task?', "You've got spirit, but you'll need more to beat Sin. An aeon duel! Show me what you're made of.", 'No time to fight? I understand. I was in your shoes once. Hmm? Changed your mind?', "Excellent. But before we begin ... (Sparkle) I've just healed your aeons for you. Let us begin! (Summons Shiva) Choose your aeon well, summoner.", 'Stop. That is enough.', 'Impressive. Remarkable talent. Traitor or no, you may have what it takes to beat Sin. Take this. You have earned it.', 'I think you will do just fine. But, if you ever feel like you want more training, seek the hidden temple of Remiem. I will be waiting there. Farewell.', 'You have a lot to learn.', 'I hope you will do better against Sin, for your sake. You need more training. That much is clear, summoner.', "The hidden temple, Remiem. I'll be waiting. Come, and I will train you.", 'Focus, and grow strong, Yuna. Farewell.', 'Welcome, Yuna.', 'Remiem Temple. Once a great religious center in the Calm Lands, lost after the battle with Sin.', "Don't send me just yet. There is still one thing left for me to do here. With the help I can give, a young summoner might just be able to defeat Sin. Well, Yuna?", "I challenge you if you cannot beat me, you'll never beat Sin.", "If you've got what it takes to beat Sin, I should be no more than a bump in your path, right?", "I will be the judge of your aeons' strength. Are you good enough, I wonder?", "You've got quite a name to live up to, daughter of Braska.", 'Well, Yuna, shall we see how well your training serves you?', 'Very well. But before we begin ... (Sparkle) Now, are you ready?', 'Choose your aeon well, summoner.', 'You have a lot to learn.', 'Stop. That is enough.', "Ah, you have made some progress, and for that, I'm glad. Take this. It may come in handy.", 'Hmm ... I see.', "(Chuckles) That's not possible. You have already surpassed your father. There is nothing more I can teach you. My work here on Spira is done. Time for me to go.", 'Welcome, Yuna.', 'Remiem Temple. Once a great religious center in the Calm Lands, lost after the battle with Sin.', "Don't send me just yet. There is still one thing left for me to do here. With the help I can give, a young summoner might just be able to defeat Sin. Well, Yuna?", "I challenge you if you cannot beat me, you'll never beat Sin.", "If you've got what it takes to beat Sin, I should be no more than a bump in your path, right?", "I will be the judge of your aeons' strength. Are you good enough, I wonder?", "You've got quite a name to live up to, daughter of Braska.", 'Well, Yuna, shall we see how well your training serves you?', 'Very well. But before we begin ... (Sparkle) Now, are you ready?', 'Choose your aeon well, summoner.', 'You have a lot to learn.', 'Stop. That is enough.', "Ah, you have made some progress, and for that, I'm glad. Take this. It may come in handy.", 'Hmm ... I see.', "(Chuckles) That's not possible. You have already surpassed your father. There is nothing more I can teach you. My work here on Spira is done. Time for me to go."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['A lady summoner!', 'Forgive me for my actions in Luca. We wanted to protect the summoner, you see?', 'Yevon found the place of our Home. Perhaps we were followed?', 'Yevon found the place of our Home. Perhaps we were followed?', 'My friend, he went to Baaj to explore. He told a story ... In the deserted temple there, faintly the Hymn of the Fayth can be heard! Maybe it has something to do with the aeons I think. Baaj is a place of mystery. Mystery worth exploring, no? In ancient times a temple was in Baaj. Now it is a nest for fiend only. There is great treasure in the deserted temple, they say. But a great fiend lives there too, and guards the treasure.', 'I have faith you will do this thing. I will sing, too, for I believe.', 'When the battle is over, we will play blitz once more!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Us? Pray? Who needs to pray? The Luca Goers always win!', 'So what\'s your goal this time? You gonna "do your best" again? Ha! It\'s too bad your best isn\'t good enough! Why even bother showing up?', 'Oooh! Play away! Just remember even kids can play, boys.', 'Who are you supposed to be?', 'Hmm?', "Oh, right. You're that idiot.", "But he is an idiot. They don't got what it takes to win the cup.", "That so? Then you're the star of a team of one.", 'Right. Whatever your Ladyship says.', 'Yo, mister star player from Zanarkand! Take it easy on us today.', "Our biggest mistake was going too easy on you Aurochs. We won't hold back next time.", 'We Luca Goers will always be on top. Crawl your way up if you think you can.', 'The Goers must always dominate. After all, our fans demand nothing less!', "Whether you're a traitor or not means nothing in the sphere pool."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['No admittance!', 'The first match has already begun. Please hurry to your seat.', 'We are currently assessing the damage from the fiends. No admittance.', 'Please report any suspicious activity.', 'Access is no longer restricted. Feel free to enter.', 'The stadium is now open. You may enter freely.', 'The people of Luca will always stand behind blitzer– even one condemned as a traitor.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Leave Kimahri, Yenke. Kimahri is small Ronso. Kimahri so small can't see Yenke and Biran's faces.", 'Maybe taught too much.', "Look! One of Kimahri's friends. Looks just like him.", 'Both follow summoners on all fours! Hornless goatlings!', 'Wrong. We come to warn little Kimahri.', "Next will be Kimahri's summoner.", 'Pitiful Kimahri! Howl alone! Howl alone!', 'Enemy of Yevon is enemy of Ronso! Leave, traitors!', 'Elder Kelk! Let Biran rend them asunder!', 'Halt!', 'Summoner may pass. Guardians may pass. Kimahri not pass! Kimahri shame Ronso brothers. Kimahri forget his birth.', 'Mountain hate the weak, hate the small. If you will climb ...', 'Think you will win? You not forget who took your horn! Never forget!', 'Biran rend you asunder!', 'Too slow.', 'Herh! This is the strength of Kimahri!', 'You win, Kimahri Ronso.', 'Strong is Kimahri. Biran is happy. Sacred Mount Gagazet! I honor the name of strong warrior who defeats Biran. Remember always, Gagazet! That name is Kimahri!', 'Summoner! We Ronso will stop pursuers from temple.', "Penance for breaking Kimahri's horn, long ago.", 'You are most fortunate summoner.', 'Then Ronso will make!', 'Summoner Yuna!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['We must report.', 'Now is the time to train, train!', 'Everyone be calm! Be calm! Fear is our enemy!', 'That was first time being so close to Sin!', 'Being on ship is bad for health. Let us kick the blitzball!', 'Soon is the final battle with Sin! How very excited I am!', 'Make this battle the last! We are counting on you!', 'When the Calm comes, we will play each day! Now we must train, train!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["... he shoots ... gooooooaaaaallll! Unbelievable! Ladies and gentleman, the day we've all been waiting for, the opening tournament of the season. This event is sponsored by Yevon. And this year we celebrate Maester Mika's 50th year in office!", "Ah, over there! The ships carrying the players are arriving now! This would be dock number 2. All the way from Kilika, it's the Kilika Beasts! High Summoner Ohalland used to play for them–a big name to live up to. Their hometown was recently attacked by Sin. Isn't that right, Jimma?", "Exciting, isn't it folks? Our next team off the ramp is ... Well, well, well! If it isn't the Besaid Aurochs! They're a living, breathing statistical impossibility! I've never seen a team this bad! That's right! In twenty-three years they've never made it past the first round! Only a few die-hard fans are in the audience today.", "Right, Jimma. Moving right along, our next team is ... Here they are, folks! Our very own Luca Goers! They've got power! They've got speed! They've got teamwork! They're an all-around first-class team! And they're back home in Luca!", 'You can say that again, Jimma. Look at the crowd, folks! Look at the crowd! Looks like all of Luca has turned out to cheer the Goers on! They know, I know, and you know, folks! The Luca Goers are number one!', 'The Aurochs are keeping the score tied with some excellent defense, folks!', "Ow! He'll feel that one in the morning!", 'Thirty seconds left! The Aurochs are launching an all-out offensive! A long pass from Letty! It goes through! Oh ... oh ... . He shoots! Goooooal! Unbelievable! The Aurochs win the match 3-2!', 'This is it, folks! In just a few minutes, the championship game!', 'But who could have imagined ... a championship game between these two teams? Our legendary Luca Goers going against ... the horrendously ill-fated Besaid Aurochs!', "They're already going at it, folks! The Goers are taunting the Aurochs!", 'What a great play! The Goers score first!', "And it's halftime!", 'The Goers are just playing great, Bobba. Really great.', "The crowd is cheering for the Aurochs! Isn't this exciting?", 'Goal! Goal! Goal! Unbelievable! What a miraculous comeback!', 'The crowd is going wild!', "The Aurochs' spirits are fading quickly! Are they going down without a fight?", "The fans are getting impatient! They're calling for some action!", 'Everyone seems to be calling for Wakka, folks!', "Say ... Where is that player going? He's leaving the sphere pool! He may be injured!", "I wonder what's happening? The crowd is going wild!", "Ah! It's Wakka! He's back on the field and ready to go! The Aurochs seem glad to have him back.", 'Unbelievable! The Aurochs win, folks! This is one for the record books!', 'The Aurochs may have lost the game, but what a way to go!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I suggest you proceed to the rear for a thorough explanation.', 'A butterfly with rainbow wings/Will lead the way to secret things. The butterfly that changes color attracts the red and blue butterflies. Red butterflies are ill omens. Get too close and they will summon deadly fiends. Blue butterflies lead to good fortune! Find seven and a treasure will be yours. Luck is a fickle thing. Traveller, find the blue butterflies as quickly as you can.', 'The butterfly that changes color attracts the red and blue butterflies. Red butterflies are ill omens. Get too close and they will summon deadly fiends. Blue butterflies lead to good fortune! Find seven and a treasure will be yours. Luck is a fickle thing. Traveller, find the blue butterflies as quickly as you can.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I really want to make Cap'n Wakka proud at this year's tournament.", 'Come practice with us once the toxin wears off, okay? Hope you get better soon, brudda.', '(muttered) Hi, there.', '(lunge and fistpump) To do our best!', '(uncertainly) Victory ... (cheering) Victory! Victory! Victory! Yay!', 'Victory, huh?', "Hey, I'll just try to stay out of your way.", "Ugh ... I-I've gotten seasick ... I think I'm gonna hurl.", 'Mm.', 'Those herbs I bought in Kilika for seasickness are working great, ya?', "I-It's terrible! Those Lucans dragged off Keepa! I ... I hope I'm next.", "Only five players in the sphere pool, ya? Which one of us is warmin' the bench?", 'People are here from Besaid, you know. We gotta win it for them!', "So, who's warmin' the bench? Could it be me?", 'A-Am I on the bench?', 'Win!', "For Cap'n Wakka!", "Cap'n!", 'Yeah!', 'Yeah!', "Cap'n ...", "I still have lots to learn from Wakka. I wish he'd come back.", 'We did our best, so I have no regrets, man.', "We're gonna keep at it, even if Wakka retires!", 'I-Is Yuna going to quit her pilgrimage? I hope she does.', "I-I'll always be on Yuna's side."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Search him!', 'Do you not speak?', 'Hey, you! Get away from there!', 'Move it! Get to work, immediately!', "Rikku! Don't interfere or you get this! (Battle tank lumbers forward) Your precious magic and aeons are sealed!", 'Get them!', 'Rikku! I will tell Father!', 'Three minutes left!', 'Father! Ready to go!', 'Whoa! It moves!', 'Whoa! It flies!', 'Whatever you say.', "Leave me be! I'm concentrating! Flying is really not my forte! Keep flying! Keep flying!", 'Father! We found Yuna!', 'I will show you!', 'Roger!', "Shoot! We're losing power!", 'Where to now?', 'Where? Where?', 'I have to warn you, thinking is not my forte. So if you want a plan, go to someone else. I have to fly the airship now. Goodbye.', '(stands up suddenly and looks ahead) Sin!', 'Father! I know what to use!', 'Wait! (Clears throat, speaks haltingly) Rikku, you ... guard.', '(Also over intercom)Shoot!', 'We are pulled by Sin!', 'Too late! It comes!', 'It is over.', 'But the main gun, it is broken!', 'Father! I cannot believe what I see!', 'Rikku, excellent!', 'Will Sin truly return again?', 'Eh ... Trust ... me. Me ... take you there. No problem ... ya?', 'You go into Sin once more, eh? Leave it to me! We will fly anywhere you want to go!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["You're a summoner?", "I'm Calli.", 'Lady Yuna, are you going to bring us the Calm?', 'Yay!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['My Lady Summoner!', "We're looking forward to another Calm, My Lady Summoner.", 'And good luck to your guardians as well.', "There are so many things I want, I can't decide what to get. Say ... will you buy something for me?", "I'm just kidding.", "Yeah, I'm kidding.", "Buy it yourself. I'm not your mom.", 'The warrior monks are real stiffs, really unapproachable. But I am grateful to them for guarding the Highroad.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['(Arriving) That is wrong! Guado go for the summoner.', "You Rikku's friends? Well, just don't stand there, come on! Let's go kick those Guado out of our Home!", 'This bites! Rikku! You read me? You go under, too! I am leveling Home! And the fiend with it!', 'No time! Go, go go!', 'Hurry, hurry! You have one minute!', 'Everyone on board?', "What'll you do when you find her, eh?", 'Hah! Words! Show me action!', "Boy, don't forget those words, 'cause if you do ... I'm gonna make you regret it.", "'Course not. That's why we're gonna look! Using this airship!", 'Yeehaa! A flight 1000 years overdue!', 'Risk big, win big!', 'Next, we use that!', 'With one of the forbidden machina! Ready? Fire!', 'Gah-hah-hah-hah!', 'Return to sand!', 'No need for tears! What is good about machina, is they can be build anew, you see?', "I'm lookin' into it, okay? Don't worry, I'm using a sphere oscillo-finder. If she's out there, we'll get her.", "It's an ancient machina. I don't know how it works either, so don't ask me, okay?", "I don't even rightly know how this rig flies, either!", "All because of the Yevon taboo on machina, we're running around in the dark here! Ain't it a rush, kiddos?", "Careful what you touch! Ship's not as stable as she looks!", "Of course! If she continues this fool pilgrimage, she will die! Sure as if you killed her yourself. No hare-brained law or teaching can send my little niece to her death! When I save her, I'll make her give up being a summoner quicker than a desert melts ice!", "Better than a dog's death! And I'll take down anyone who don't agree!", "Good! Then it's settled!", "First, we rescue Yuna! Let's show 'em what we got!", 'Where!?', "Easy, kiddo. Bevelle's defenses are top-notch.", 'Heh! You got guts. Set course to Bevelle! Full speed ahead!', "It'll take a while to get to Bevelle. Meanwhile ...", "They grabbed Yuna back in the Sanubia Desert. One of the Guado squads that attacked Home found her. Hah! Wedding, my britches! Now while I'm around! Those Yevon rockheads! I'll give 'em something to remember!", "You're awfully calm about it!", 'Eh?', "Eh, relax! The ship's still got some fight left in her! Let 'em take their best shot!", "(Over ship's intercom) Rikku, you read me? We're gonna fight that thing! Get on deck and show him what you got! Go!", "What are you doin' loafin' around? Get out there and get that dragon!", "We gotta keep our distance, boys, but we can't let her get too far away. You all have to tell me when to move! But tell me quick, eh? This rig ain't so nimble, you hear?", 'Wait a moment!!', 'Just a minute!', 'Hold on!', "Don't be falling now!", "This is it! I'm hitting it with all we got!", "We're out of ammo? This really isn't my day ...", 'Hey! I see Bevelle!', "Aren't we the happy lookin' bunch.", "We'll wait till you think of a plan. Get that noggin working!", "Well, that sounds like a plan to me! My baby here'll take us anywhere we want! Yee-hah! Here we go!", "Don't let it bother you. Hey, I'm guilty of hating those durn Yevonites, myself! Well ... There's a lot of folk in this world–some of 'em good, some of 'em bad. That's all there is to it.", "The final showdown with Sin! I say let's get this show on the road!", 'Yee-haw! Here we go!', 'Well, this is it, eh?', 'Well, that sounds pretty simple.', 'You got that right.', "Right, got you covered! Yeah. (Starts broadcasting Hymn of the Fayth from ship's speakers) How's that?", 'Hey, how you plan on getting inside?', "(Cackles) Now that's what I call a plan!", 'Aha! Of course!', "All right! We'll give that thing a new blowhole. All you gotta do is jump!", "I won't tell ya to be careful. Do your worst, kiddo!", "(Over ship intercom) Hey, I saw somethin' shine on the base of Sin's arm! I reckon its a weak spot!", 'What, what?', 'Everyone, back inside!', 'Just a minute!', 'Wait a moment!', "Yeehaw! We're going in! Hold on!", 'Here goes! Everyone, hold on to something! Here we go!', "Couldn't have done it without you! All right! Everyone look sharp! Time to hit the other side!", 'Ready? Fire!', 'Yeehaw! Where next?', 'What? We have only begun!', 'Th-That cannot be!', 'Dang it! All right, back inside! Time for another plan!', "Believe it, son! They've done it! It is happening!", "What? You're kidding me!", "We're countin' on you, kid. Yee-ha! Here we go!", "Well, son, the main gun is still busted! We can't give you any cover fire!", "All right. Take us up, flush to the mouth! No mistakes, or I'm gonna tear out that mop you call hair!", 'Here we go!', "We're counting on you, kid. (Map opens) Yee-haw, here we go!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['You have to leave your chocobos here. Come on, everyone off!', 'All the other Crusaders are preparing for the operation. But they put me here on guard duty.', "This is all I'm good for anyway.", 'Gee, Captain Lucil and Elma should have been here by now.', "What's taking Elma so long?", 'You have to leave your chocobos here! Come on, everyone off!', 'Gee. Captain Lucil and Elma should have been here by now.', '(Comes running out) Excuse me, Lady Summoner Yuna?', "The command center ... Maester Seymour requests your presence there, ma'am.", "Take that road to the command center. it's not far. We're still in the midst of preparations this way. Sorry.", "No, not this way, that way. I guess I'm not good at explaining.", "I'm just doing my job.", 'We make pretty poor Chocobo Mounted Forces without chocobos.', 'We should never have ignored the teachings.', "I've been thinking about the future.", "No matter what we do next ... we're going to do it for Yevon, that's for sure.", '(Running from temple) Captain! Waaaaait for meee!', 'You (pant, pant) expect me to keep up with a chocobo!?', "Eh!? C-Can't I just rest a sec ... ?", 'Uh ... He does have a point, though.', "Hey, I didn't say that. Just ...", "But ... that'll take days!", 'Oh, boy ...', 'Hi there. Would you look at this? They always leave me behind.', 'Oh. You want me to scratch you? There.', 'Good boy!', "I've always been able to tell how chocobos feel. Maybe I'd make a better chocobo breeder than Chocobo Knight, huh? Hey, what job do you see me doing?", 'Oh ... Really? For a moment, I thought you\'d say "breeder." We\'ll have to get some new chocobos to rebuild our unit. I wonder how long that\'s gonna take. Ah, well ...', 'Yeah! I think so too! Hmm ... You know, I might just give it a try. Should I resign my commission? Would Captain Lucil let me? Elma would probably laugh at me.', "Wow, I think this is the first time I've seriously thought about my life.", "Um ... Shouldn't you go rescue them?", 'Nice to see you again!', "Yeah, I did. Elma was upset with me, but Captain Lucil understood. Now, I'm working as a chocobo breeder on this ship. I really, really love taking care of chocobos! Being with chocobos all the time ... I think I've found my calling! And it's all thanks to you! Thank you!", "Oh, yeah! I found this in one of the chocobo nests the other day. It's no use to me, so I want you to have it.", "Ah, I have to go now. It's time for lunch.", "I meant I have to feed the chocobos. They get really upset if they're not fed! See you!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I gotta stop closing my eyes when the ball comes down.', "You being a blitzball player's probably what saved you out there. The best players–they can hold their breath, like, forever! I wish I could do that.", "We had an underwater race once, ya? To see how long we could go. Two laps and we were out, but Cap'n Wakka went five, no sweat!", "That toxin's nasty stuff, ya? You should go rest up. What am I saying? Take this, it might help!", '(muttered) Hi, there.', '(lunge and fistpump) To do our best!', '(uncertainly) Victory ... (cheering) Victory! Victory! Victory! Yay!', "Hey, I was hoping you'd join the team all along, ya?", "Now that you're with us, we got nothing to fear!", "Someday we'll earn some respect, just like Yuna.", 'If anyone can defeat Sin the daughter of Lord Braska can!', 'Please take good care of yourself. Just remember that your well-being means a lot to us.', "A summoner's confident smile is always a great encouragement to us.", "For both father and daughter to become summoners–it must have been Yevon's will.", "Victory will be ours! Victory! Victory! We're taking home that cup, no matter what it takes, ya?", '(trying to bounce ball on head) Yaah! Haah! Arrrgh!', "runs by Hey! You awake? Cap'n Wakka's waitin' for you!", 'Mm.', 'L-Look out!', 'You sure are talented, man. Playing blitzball and fighting like that!', "I came here last year to fight for victory, but we lost in the first round. I guess I didn't pray hard enough, ya?", "My poor knees were shakin' when the Goers confronted me.", "Tournament's coming up real soon. I wish we had more time to practice, ya?", "Looks like the toxin's still getting to you. Take it easy and go to bed early, ya?", "We wanted to have our final practice in Kilika, but that's impossible after what happened to the place.", 'I feel a little nervous with Lady Yuna watching us, ya?', 'Yeow ... I-I hurt my back.', 'We sure stood out, though!', 'At the match-up draws.', "Cap'n Wakka!", "You come back soon. We are really countin' on you.", "I wish I had a big net for all the butterflies in Wakka's stomach. I hope he's okay.", "Sure you're all right, Cap'n?", 'Lady Yuna!', 'It may be last minute, but wanna go over the rules?', 'Win!', "Cap'n!", "Goers are goin' down!", 'Yeah!', 'Yeah!', "You really leavin', Cap'n?", 'Yeah, but ...', "Cap'n ...", 'Yes! Thank you! We beat the Goers all because of you, man.', "We didn't win the cup, but we did win a game for the first time in twenty-three years. It's all good, ya?", "Don't worry 'bout the Aurochs. We're all in high spirits.", "Is it true that Yuna is gettin' married?", "No one's gonna believe that Yuna is a traitor, man."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I envy your happy-go-lucky atttitude.', "Are you a blitzer? Or a guardian? Don't tell me you're both!", 'He should stop wasting his time with all those poses, and devote more time to praying.', "There's a strange rumor going around about singing the Hymn of the Fayth when a ship flies by.", 'I wonder what the summoners fighting Sin are like?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['A summoner, are you?', 'Dona.', "So, you're High Summoner Braska's daughter. That's quite a name to live up to.", 'My, my, my ... And all these people are your guardians? My, what a rabble! As I recall, Lord Braska had only two guardians. Quality over quantity, my dear. Whatever were you thinking? I have need of only one guardian. Right, Barthello?', "You do what you want. Barthello, we're leaving.", "Where's Yuna?", 'Then why are you here?', 'Hmmm. Not a guardian, you say?', 'Just a little game.', 'Some people can be so rude.', "How many times do I have to tell you? I'm a summoner!", "You dare impede a summoner's pilgrimage?", 'Useless!', "Oh, it's you. As you can see, not even summoners can pass. But they'll call on us in the end. Just wait and see.", 'Well, well. You again. Still travelling around with quite the crowd, I see.', 'What is it, Barthello? You know this riffraff?', 'Barthello, enough! Get back here!', "Please! Touch me with that hand and I'll remove it!", "How much longer? She sure is taking her sweet time. We've got places to go. We can't be kept waiting like this.", "You owe much to your father. All these guardians ... and Sir Auron too? And I hear Maester Seymour's quite taken with you. The world must look different when you're the daughter of Lord Braska.", "Oh, is that so? Then try standing on your own two legs for once. Your guardians won't be able to protect you when the time comes.", "She's not here.", 'Hello again. Wait there until we have performed the sending.', 'We all live in fear of Sin. You know that.', "Look, I'm really tired. Leave me. If it's not an emergency, would you mind leaving?", "Wait ... There's something I want to ask you. What would you think if I said I ... I was giving up my pilgrimage?", 'Unusual. Most people would never forgive a summoner who quit.', 'Behind my back, they would say I was abandoning my duty.', 'Easy for you to say. But ... you do have a point. Maybe Barthello and I should go someplace far away.', 'Show some sympathy!', "You're right. Quitting now would be sort of anti-climactic, no? Tell Yuna something, would you? Tell her she still has a rival me! Tell her she'd better do her best, or be bested. You'll tell her, won't you?", "It's too cramped to call aeons in here. I'll leave this fight to you. Show us your stuff!", 'What good is this place? All that trouble getting here, only to find ruins!', 'Wh-What do you mean?', "And this plan's going to work?", "So, you're saying it's all in your hands now? Fine, you do what you like, however you like. I'll just wait my turn. Well, it doesn't matter who does the deed, but are you sure you're up to it?", "Oh, I'm sure you will. Barthello, shall we?", "Why, it's you again.", "Yes, but we're not going to Zanarkand.", "I have decided to go to Barthello's homeland.", "We are going to let the other summoners deal with Sin. (Sigh) I'm ... I'm scared.", '(Gasp) You mean ... the Final Summoning?', 'Well, whatever it is ... good luck!', 'Do your best. Barthello? Time to go.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Hey, that boy in the Aurochs is a cutie.', 'Now, what should we play next?', "We didn't lose to the Aurochs, we lost to Wakka's spirit and dedication.", "Great game! So you're not just a pretty boy after all.", "You're a guardian now, right? Are you still going to blitz?", 'You always seem to be walking around. When do you have time to practice?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Those Guado! They will feel my fury in the blitz sphere!', 'This I leave to you! Battle was never my forte.', 'I long for the sands of Bikanel. Desert it may be, but there is no place like home! The lord Mika, an unsent? But I saw him in Luca.', 'The lord Mika, an unsent? But I saw him in Luca.', 'If every mouth in Spira sings, we may win this battle.', 'You will attack Sin head on? Truly a great warrior are you!', 'Never have I thought of flying into Sin! Not even in dreams!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["And I'm Elma. We've been charged to guard the Highroad.", 'Our prayers are with you.', 'Hey! Stop loafing around!', 'Summoners and guardians! I saw the fight. I was impressed!', 'I took care of that fiend for you.', "Right now we're charged with getting people off the Highroad. But you ... Well, you have a summoner, so you can stay. (whispers) Don't tell anyone, but this is a really boring job.", 'Evacuation of civilians almost complete, sir!', 'Sir!', 'Lady Summoner! What are you doing here?', "Well, with your guardians near you shouldn't have anything to worry about.", "Don't say we shouldn't be using machina! Not now, please?", 'I hope Captain Lucil notices my efforts in this mission!', 'Of all our chocobos, only this one made it.', "It's just you, now. But don't worry, we're here for you!", 'The monks said we could stay here for a while.', "This little fella's finally calmed down.", "We won't defy Yevon. Never again.", 'Once we find chocobos, our Mounted Forces will ride again!', "What took you so long? We're leaving!", "Ma'am!", 'No complaints!', "This guy won't let our chocobo on the shoopuf!", "It's just not fair!", 'So, what? We just leave him behind?', "That's our captain!", "Maester Seymour's people are expecting you.", "We're on watch duty at the temple at least until the wedding's done. Anyone tries to crash our party, we'll send 'em packing!", "oh, yeah, Clasko's back there with the chocobo. Stop and say hi if you've got the time.", "Next time you see us, we'll be the proud Chocobo Knights once again!", "This isn't the way to the temple! Weren't you listening to Captain Lucil?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Be on guard. There're fiends on the road today!", 'Hey, you! You were attacked by Sin ... right? Recently was it?', "So, Sin can't be far, right? You're not hiding anything, are you?", "You're kidding, right?", 'Yes, sir!', "The Crusaders are sworn to battle Sin! We have chapters throughout Spira, accepting all who wish to join our struggle! The hero Mi'ihen formed the Crusaders eight hundred years ago as the Crimson Blades. Later, our ranks grew and we called ourselves the Crusaders. We've been fighting Sin ever since!", "Is Sin's toxin really this bad, sir?", "But soon, we may be able to finally defeat Sin. We've got a plan–one that'll go down in Crusader history!", 'Restricted area! Our operation depends on this cargo!', "Why don't you go topside? The fresh sea breeze might help restore your memory!", 'Company, halt!', 'Standing guard, sir!', "Told you it'd be rough going in there.", 'Whoa.', 'Sir, we should fight, too!', "Young Crusaders, gather round! We'll beat Sin into the ground!", 'Hey, after the tournament, you should join the Crusaders!', "Hmm? Whatcha doing here? The tournament's about to start!", "Everyone's either at the stadium or watching the game on the sphere. (chuckle) They love their blitzball.", "But ... but we're still on duty. What about the mission, sir?", "You'd better be winning when we get there.", 'Hey, we saw the game! You guys were great!', 'Uh ... The lady summoner and her guardians ...', 'Right ... sir.', 'We should be going, sir!', 'Show me how to play blitz sometime!', 'Why only you, sir? I want to fight, too!', "I'm not a cadet anymore, sir! Let me go with you, and I'll prove it to them!", '(Sounding flat) The operation will begin shortly. Please check all your equipment.', 'Of course not! I came here to fight Sin! But they stick me here!', 'Huh?', "Just doing what they say? It just won't be enough.", "That's right! It's not fair!", "You'd think the same if you were me.", "I'll do something ... even if it means bending the rules.", "That's right! It's not fair!", '(Rushes in and salutes) All troops ready to move at your command, sir!', "What's ... going on? Why? What?", "What's going on?!", "Luzzu, he's ...", 'What ... what do I do now?', "I can't do this ... I'm going back to Besaid!", "Luzzu, he's ...", "I'm going back to Besaid. With Luzzu gone ...", "Most of the other Crusaders have already left. I'll go soon. I heard you're leaving too. Good luck. I hope we meet again someday.", "Advance toward the shore killing every fiend you see. And don't let your guard down even when you get there! Report immediately if Sin appears!", "'Lo!", 'What, this? Just training!', "You never know when Sin will come. We have to keep sharp for the village's sake. But really, my heart's heavy. It's not like I can go around crying in front of my men.", "Maybe you're right.", "I'd better be going. My men await.", '(Bows head in thanks) You, too.', "I hear Sin really made a mess of Bevelle, eh? The Farplane's ringing with Luzzu's laughter, I bet. Just a little more, and Sin is finished!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Many Ronso return home to mountain. But Ronso Fangs will stay in Luca.', 'Ronso home on mighty Mt. Gagazet. Our mountain protects sacred ruins of Zanarkand.', 'Maester Kelk Ronso was slain while defending the mountain. For Ronso, no better way to die.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['We Guado protect the Farplane so the dead can rest in peace.', 'I beg you, please tell no one about Lord Jyscal. Why, if word leaked out that the lord of the Guado and a maester of Yevon wandered from the Farplane ... we Guado would become the laughingstock of all Spira! Yevon have mercy upon us.', 'We Guado will solve our own problems. Please understand.', 'The Guado are deeply saddened by the loss of so many of our own. If only I could restore their cheer through blitzball. No Guado has the strength to weave dark conspiracies any more.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["We've been praying for some competition this year!", 'Ah, I remember him. Guy from Kilika.', "You know, one of the Besaid Aurochs. Said somethin' about winning the cup.", 'Yeah, as if anyone lived in those ruins.', "Let's see them moves you've learned in those ruins then!", 'I consider your victory a total fluke.', 'Just be grateful that your twenty-three-year losing streak is finally over.', 'Instead of wasting so much time strolling around, why not work on your game?', "We're going to keep on blitzing no matter what becomes of the temple."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I heard the Sin toxin got to you. Took your memory, eh?', "I'd be happy to teach you anything you've forgotten, sonny.", "How could you forget Sin? I can't say I don't envy you, though. There's many who would give anything to forget the pain Sin has brought. Sin appeared a thousand years ago, a raging demon intent on reducing Spira to rubble. Everyone in Spira lives under Sin's shadow. But to forget Sin ... well, I'd consider yourself lucky, eh? Something else you'd like to know, eh?", "The foul vapors that boil from Sin's hide are evil indeed ... One breath, and it will taint the very core of your body. People who get too close to Sin forget even the most important things. Just like you, eh? Something else you'd like to know, eh?", "How wretched you must be, to have forgotten the teachings of Yevon! The teachings are the only salvation for those who suffer becasuse of Sin. I'm sure you followed the teachings, before the toxin got to you, of course. Go pray at the temple, and all will return in time. Something else you'd like to know, eh?", "Zanarkand was once a great city in the far north of this land. Now it lies in a ruin, destroyed by Sin a thousand years ago. Such was its punishment for relying too much on machina. Something else you'd like to know, eh?", "Sorry I can't do more to help. You understand, eh, sonny? The whole village's all wound up, with the apprentice not back from the trials.", "All this worrying's no good for an old man like myself.", 'You heathen!', 'Lady Yuna! Be careful!', "I'm sure you'd like to know more before you head out, eh?", "Some wild youngsters are saying the Aurochs won after a 23-year losing streak! Yeah, well that'll be the day! Aurochs winning? Heh! Heheh!", 'Looks like you got over the toxin. Praise be to Yevon, eh?', "We Besaiders all know Lady Yuna's no traitor. The daughter of Lord Braska turning against Yevon? Hogwash! We simple folk ain't got a clue what them temple elders are thinking.", "I think I'll stick around long enough to see Sin get what's coming to it! Heh!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Aurochs ... Don't underestimate Ronso skill.", 'The honorable warrior tribe Ronso fight enemies fair and square.', 'Ronso are pious race. But cannot trust temple now.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I beg your pardon, but may I ask your name?', 'As I thought! The daughter of Lord Braska. You have the look of your father.', 'No, I have never met the man. Ah, my apologies. (Yevon bow) I am Isaaru. I am a summoner, like you.', "Since I was a child, I've always looked up to Lord Braska. I wished I would someday become a high summoner like he was.", "You must have some of your father's talent in you! I believe you might someday defeat Sin.", "(Smiles) Of course, I've no intention of losing, either. So perhaps we should race to see who can defeat Sin first, no?", 'Yuna, I beg your leave. Good luck, to both of us!', "Now, we go to Kilika. From there we take the ferry, perhaps as far as Besaid. I hear Operation Mi'ihen did not go well ... We summoners must do our part, before another fool plan wastes more lives.", 'Hey, you.', "You are Yuna's guardian, no? Maroda's heard a curious rumor. I thought you should know.", 'It could just be the fiends got them ... but not so many so quickly.', 'Please, be careful.', 'Pacce!', "We're leaving!", "They died ... protecting us. It's not much, but the least we can do is give them a proper sending.", 'But that is our choice ...', "A world without Sin ... That is the dream of all Yevon's children. And we will use that power, even if it means our lives!", 'We owe our lives to the Al Bhed. However, no matter how much they beg, we cannot quit our pilgrimage.', "I've known since I was a child. My will is set. If I do not do it, someone else must, you understand.", "I'm amazed this thing can fly, truly! It must be sacrilege to think so highly of a machina. I feel uneasy just riding it!", 'Motion sickness? What infirmity is that?', 'As soon as we land, we continue the pilgrimage!', 'Let him rest.', "We'll leave the other compartments to you."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["What are you lookin' at? I ain't on display here! Go away, man.", "I let down my team because of the toxin ... But I'm okay now. I'd better start practicing again.", 'I let my teammates down, so this time I gotta work twice as hard to make up for it.', "I'm gonna win lots of money playing blitzball and help rebuild Kilika!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['That shot was spectacular, brudda! Wish I could shoot like that.', "Cap'n Wakka's waiting for you. You better get going, ya? There's fiends on the road, ya? Use this if you get into trouble.", '(muttered) Hi, there.', '(lunge and fistpump) To do our best!', '(uncertainly) Victory ... (cheering) Victory! Victory! Victory! Yay!', "Everyone's acting like we already won! Not that I can blame them, ya?", 'You should get to sleep early, brudda. Get some rest.', "Hey, don't let it get to you. It's the same as always, ya?", "I'm so tired of practicing passes. I wanna do some shooting, too!on top deck Hey, can you believe this?!", 'Mm.', "I just want to sneak up behind them and beat the ... I mean, I wanna get in their faces and show 'em what we're made of!", 'We can finally relax now that the Goers are down in the cabin.', "Don't mind Kimahri for not answering you. He's the silent type, you know?", "I'm gonna tell Botta and Keepa all about that shot you just did. They'll be so mad when they find out what they missed!", "I'm glad the Goers weren't here to see it. Let's keep it secret until the finals!", 'We were?', 'The year before that, and the one before that, too!', "I know we only need to win twice, but that's the problem.", "We've never made it past the first round! I'm gettin' the jitters.", "We're playing the Goers, too.", "I should've been the one injured, not Wakka ...", 'Win!', "Cap'n!", 'Yeah!', 'Yeah!', "Cap'n ...", "Still can't believe we won, man ... Have to keep pinching myself.", "Wakka said he retired, but maybe he'll come back if we beg him?", "So you are Yuna's guardian, too? Lulu's pretty strict, ya?", "I can't imagine Yuna and Maester Seymour as a couple.", "I already knew about Yuna's lineage. I just kept my mouth shut in front of Wakka."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Hey!', 'HEY!', "(Interrupts offscreen) Hey! Stop dreaming! You, with a woman? You can't even catch a ball!", "Oh, what's the matter? (Yuna and Rikku appear beside him) Gonna cry again? Cry, cry. That's the only thing you're good for!", "Huh? What'd you say?", 'Eh?', 'Well, well, trying to follow in my footsteps, are you?', 'I usually charge for lessons, you know ...', 'That shot is done ... like this!', "You can't do it, kid. But don't worry, my boy. You're not the only one. No one else can do it. I'm the best!", 'No one else can do it.', "I'm the best!", "You're out of your league!", "You can't do it, kid.", "(Voice) Told you you couldn't do it!", 'What?', "Let them talk. I'm still the best.", "I can quit drinkin' whenever I want!", 'What did you say?', 'Heh. Tomorrow, maybe.', 'Why do today what you can leave for tomorrow?', 'There he goes again ... crying!', 'See? So I told him what I thought of him, right there!', "'Course!", "Ah, go to him. He'll cry if you don't.", "Well, you said it was gonna be a long trip. We'll be seeing a lot of neat things, right? So I thought I'd record it all in this. To show to my wife and kid, you know.", "Hey, Braska. Ain't this supposed to be a grand occasion? Where're the cheering fans? The crying women?", 'Hmm ... If you say so. Well, it better be a lot more colorful when we come back. A parade for Braska, vanquisher of Sin!', "What's the matter? Afraid I might bite?", "Braska! You should take one, too. It'd make a great gift for little Yuna!", "What's the hurry, man?", "Hey. If you're sitting there, watching this ... it means you're stuck in Spira, like me. You might not know when you'll get back home, but you better not be crying! Although, I guess I'd understand. But you know what? There's a time when you have to stop crying and move on. You'll be fine. Remember, you're my son. And ... Well, uh ... Never mind. I'm no good at these things.", 'Anyways ... I believe in you. Be good. Goodbye.', "Hey, Braska. You don't have to do this.", 'Fine. (Folds arms) I said my piece.', 'Are the Trials ahead?', 'Here, too, huh? Gimme a break. I was expecting, you know, parades and ... fireworks!', 'Huh? What do you mean no Final Aeon?', "This is the only way we got now! Fine. Make me the fayth. I been doing some thinking. My dream is back in the other Zanarkand. I wanted to make that runt into a star blitz player. Show him the view from the top, you know. But now I know there's no way home for me. I'm never gonna see him again. My dream's never gonna come true. So make me the fayth. I'll fight Sin with you, Braska. Then maybe my life will have meaning, you know.", "Believe me, I thought this through. Besides ... I ain't gettin' any younger, so I might as well make myself useful.", "What! You're not gonna try to stop me, too?", 'Braska still has to fight Sin, Auron. Guard him well. Make sure he gets there.', "Well, let's go.", 'What do you want now?', "I understand what you're saying, Auron. I'll find a way to break the cycle.", 'Can I ask you one last favor? Uh ... Nah. Never mind.', "Okay. Listen good. Take care of my son. My son, in Zanarkand. He's such a crybaby. He needs someone there to hold his hand, see? Take care of him, will you?", "Hey! You said it yourself! There must be a way to get there, right? You'll find it.", "Thanks, Auron. You were always such a stiff, but that's what I liked about you.", 'Smallest heap of huts I ever seen!', "(From off-camera) What are you guys doin'? Let's go!", "I'm so hungry I could eat a shoopuf whole!", "After you get that aeon from Besaid ... Where're we going?", "Zanarkand, huh? It's been in ruins for a thousand years, right?", 'Thanks for trying, Auron.', "I thought if I went with you guys I might find a way to go back. But it's not that easy.", "No need to apologize, Braska. It's not your fault. I should be thinking about fighting Sin now, anyway. Zanarkand can wait. But I will find my way back!", "Hey, I'll be all right. You're the one that should be careful. Wouldn't want your little girl to cry.", 'Hey, Auron! Did you get that last match?', 'Not a sportsman, are ya?', "My form don't need no work. I'm the great Jecht. It's for my kid.", "Yeah, and he wants to beat his old man bad. Once, I told him to give it up. He didn't speak to me for a week. Wonder what he's doing now. I hope he got bigger and put on some muscle.", "Hey, what's the big idea! Stop shooting!", "Hmph. What's it waiting for? Hey! Come out and fight!", "Hey, come on! It's the right thing to do! Everyone's depending on us. Besides, it's good practice.", "There it is! Auron! Let's get 'im!", 'What are you shooting me for?', "I said I was sorry. It's never gonna happen again! I promise!", "That's it. Only thing I drink from now on is shoopuf milk!", "We're on a journey to fight Sin and save Spira, right? If I keep screwin' up ... and ... making a fool of myself ... my wife and kid are never gonna forgive me.", "You're late, Auron.", '(Turns and waves to Tidus) Hey.', "Hah! You got tall, but you're all bones! You eating right, boy?", "You've really grown.", 'Well, I am Sin, you know.', "Well, then ... I mean ... you know. Let's end this.", 'Yeah?', '(Chuckles) I know, I know. You know what you have to do.', "I can't hear the Hymn so well anymore. Pretty soon, I'm gonna be Sin. Completely. I'm glad you're here now. One thing, though ... When it starts, I won't be myself anymore. I won't be able to hold myself back. I'm sorry.", "You're right. Well, then ... Let's go!", "You'll cry. You're gonna cry. You always cry. See? You're cryin'.", 'Save it for later.', "Good. That's right. You are my son, after all.", 'Heh.', "No, Yuna, there's no time!", 'Yuna, you know what to do. The aeons ...', 'Call them!', 'Who are you?', 'What of it?', "Hmm. Sounds sweet. What's the catch?", 'Seriously?', "Great, let's go!", 'Anything to get outta here!', 'Hey! You want to step in here and say that?', "Stop gabbin' and get me outta here!", 'Ahh ... Free at last!', "Right, right. So, what's a summer-ner, anyway?", "Well, you said it was gonna be a long trip. We'll be seeing a lot of neat things, right? So I thought I'd record it all in this. To show to my wife and kid, you know.", "Hey, Braska. Ain't this supposed to be a grand occasion? Where're the cheering fans? The crying women?", 'Hmm ... If you say so. Well, it better be a lot more colorful when we come back. A parade for Braska, vanquisher of Sin!', "What's the matter? Afraid I might bite?", "Braska! You should take one, too. It'd make a great gift for little Yuna!", "What's the hurry, man?", "Hey. If you're sitting there, watching this ... it means you're stuck in Spira, like me. You might not know when you'll get back home, but you better not be crying! Although, I guess I'd understand. But you know what? There's a time when you have to stop crying and move on. You'll be fine. Remember, you're my son. And ... Well, uh ... Never mind. I'm no good at these things.", 'Anyways ... I believe in you. Be good. Goodbye.', 'Hey, Auron! Did you get that last match?', 'Not a sportsman, are ya?', "My form don't need no work. I'm the great Jecht. It's for my kid.", "Yeah, and he wants to beat his old man bad. Once, I told him to give it up. He didn't speak to me for a week. Wonder what he's doing now. I hope he got bigger and put on some muscle.", "Hey, what's the big idea! Stop shooting!", "Hmph. What's it waiting for? Hey! Come out and fight!", "Hey, come on! It's the right thing to do! Everyone's depending on us. Besides, it's good practice.", "There it is! Auron! Let's get 'im!", 'What are you shooting me for?', "I said I was sorry. It's never gonna happen again! I promise!", "That's it. Only thing I drink from now on is shoopuf milk!", "We're on a journey to fight Sin and save Spira, right? If I keep screwin' up ... and ... making a fool of myself ... my wife and kid are never gonna forgive me.", 'Hey! Hold it steady!', "(In distance) This is important! No foolin' around! (Camera pans to left and crops him out) You're gonna spoil it!", 'Whoa!', 'Whoa!', 'Yeah, yeah ...', "After you get that aeon from Besaid ... Where're we going?", "Zanarkand, huh? It's been in ruins for a thousand years, right?", 'Thanks for trying, Auron.', "I thought if I went with you guys I might find a way to go back. But it's not that easy.", "No need to apologize, Braska. It's not your fault. I should be thinking about fighting Sin now, anyway. Zanarkand can wait. But I will find my way back!", "Hey, I'll be all right. You're the one that should be careful. Wouldn't want your little girl to cry.", 'Smallest heap of huts I ever seen!', "(From off-camera) What are you guys doin'? Let's go!", "I'm so hungry I could eat a shoopuf whole!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Yes, Bobba. They're going to be pulling out all the stops to try and bring back the cup this year.", 'Best of luck to them and a safe journey back to Besaid.', "Without a doubt, they are the favorite this year, Bobba. And after the way they dominated last year, it'd take a miracle for them to lose today.", "Ah! But the referee doesn't call the foul! Wakka's taking a real beating out there.", 'This looks like history in the making, Bobba.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Since childhood, I have played only blitz! It is true!', 'I hoped only to rest at Home a while then return to Luca.', 'You are a traitor, no? Then you are one with the Al Bhed!', 'Both Yunalesca and Mika were dead, yet they clung to Spira tightly.', 'Pardon me. So scared was I that I began to tremble all over!', 'I wish the battles would be over ...', 'Going inside Sin ... I sang in fright and would not stop!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Give them a balloon and they're happy campers. Kids are so innocent and easy to please.", "It's that child who helps me forget about Sin's existence. Even if it's only for a moment.", "I'm so worried. What if the fiends that appeared in the stadium find their way into the city?", "The Crusaders may use machina in their operation. If so, they're no different from the Al Bhed.", 'The ship at dock number 3 brought lots of warrior monks to Luca. I feel much safer now.', 'Not all of the Crusaders are armed well. They seem inferior to the warrior monks.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Oooooohhh ...', 'What I am about to tell you is the unclouded truth. I swear it on my honor as a Guado. Listen to me very carefully, for I shall tell you the truth about my son, Seymour. His mind is closed even to me, a maester of Yevon. But I can feel flames of darkness burning in his heart. He is using Yevon, the Guado, and even the summoners. If he is not stopped, he will surely bring destruction and chaos to Spira. I will leave this world soon, killed by my own son. But I do not fault him. Because I was not wise enough, he has suffered, and become twisted. I could not protect him and his mother from the world and its cruelty. I will accept death as punishment for my deeds. But whoever is watching this ... I implore you to stop Seymour! Stop my son.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Hey, I'll admit it, we're not the best blitzers in Spira.", '"To do our best!" That\'s our motto. Guess it\'s not enough, though. Here, take this. And do your best, ya?', "We're always top dogs for the first few minutes of the game, ya? Then we start to run out of breath. That's when they get us. But Cap'n Wakka, man, he don't stop! No halftime breath for him, ya? He just keeps going!", '(muttered) Hi, there.', '(lunge and fistpump) To do our best!', '(uncertainly) Victory ... (cheering) Victory! Victory! Victory! Yay!', 'Hit the other team hard and make it easy on the goalkeeper, ya?', 'We head out on the same boat tomorrow!', "He seems real sick, ya? I'm hiding over here, 'cause I'm gonna get sick too if I keep watching him.", 'If you see one guy throw up, you sorta get sick too, you know?', "Hey! Wakka's waitin' for you!", 'Mm.', "Urgh ... Why do I feel like I'm being watched?", 'H-Help!', "Well, we would've lost to anyone anyway.", 'Play to win, play to win, play to win ... Gotta keep reminding myself, ya?', "I'll make all the saves, so you just go out and shoot!", "Yuna will be watchin', ya? Gotta play hard!", 'Win!', "Cap'n!", 'Yeah!', 'Yeah!', "Cap'n ...", 'We won! That means we are the team to watch out for. Unbelievable.', "If only I had done better, we could have won. I'm sorry, man.", 'Lord Braska visited Besaid ten years ago. He had an amusing guardian with him.', 'You saw Chappu on the Farplane? Kinda looked like you, ya?', "Actually, I'm relieved to hear that Yuna's wedding is called off."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Summoner Yuna and guardians, leave here at once!', 'Gagazet is Ronso land, sacred mountain of Yevon. The mountain will not bear the footsteps of infidels!', 'Then you will die by those words!', 'A summoners and her guardians ...', 'You have been branded a traitor, but still you would fight Sin? Lost to the temple, hated by the people, yet you continue your pilgrimage? Everything lost! What do you fight for?', 'Even sacrificing yourself? (Ponders a while.) Ronso, let them pass! Summoner Yuna, your will is stronger than steel. Tempered steel that even the mightiest Ronso could not hope to bend. Yuna, we bow to your will! Now go! The sacred heights of Gagazet welcome you.', "Summoner Yuna's words, they ring clear in my soul. Small voice, small frame, but a will that towers over Gagazet's peak. The path to the sacred heights is steep and lined with the dens of fiends. Strong guardians, be prepared, and guard your summoner well. Guard your summoner with all your heart."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['A fiend! In human disguise!', 'Sit, captive!', 'Insolence!', "If you're near death, really near death, use this! Go on, earn your pay.", 'Under us! Under us!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["(With repeated poking, he'll uncross his arms, shake his head, and eventually shove Tidus, causing Yuna to giggle and Tidus to backflip).", 'In dark times she must be. She must shine bright.', 'Now are dark times. Yuna tries hard.', 'If we worry, she tries harder. Do not frown.', 'Kimahri try, too.', 'Pick spot. Shut up. Wait. You grow stronger, but are still a pup.', 'Dona has left. Isaaru, too.', 'You come to insult Kimahri?', 'Kimahri will deal with them.', 'Kimahri alone.', "It's Kimahri's problem. We can't interfere; it's a rule.", 'Shoopuf shook. Yuna fall in water. Shoopuf scoop up Yuna with long nose. Yuna jump in three more times for fun. Kimahri worried.', 'Yuna had fun. Kimahri happy.', 'Biran is troublemaker, but Ronso do not lie. Summoners disappearing–that was not lie.', '(Sniff, sniff) Smells like oil.', 'Kimahri fail as guardian on shoopuf. Kimahri never fail again.', 'Kimahri not like Maester Seymour.', 'Kimahri speak no more.', 'Kimahri speak no more.', '(Emerging from shop) Guado potions good. Buy some before leaving.', 'Yuna resting. Go away. Kimahri said go away.', 'Temple not far. Why stop here?', 'Ronso are followers of Yevon. Ronso dislike Al Bhed.', 'Not Kimarhi. Al Bhed are Al Bhed. Rikku is Rikku. Rikku swore to protect Yuna. And Rikku is not a liar. Kimarhi can tell. So, she is a friend.', 'Kimarhi is surprised.', 'Kimahri think you are kind.', 'Yuna will wake soon. Kimahri knows this. No sign of enemy.', 'We climb.', 'Only those who try will become.', 'Kimahri think Rikku should stay Rikku.', 'This place smell different now. Kimahri not know if this good or bad. Kimahri feel no danger.', 'Yuna ... gone.', "It's quiet. Kimahri goes now.", 'Yuna!', 'Kimahri never forget the Al Bhed sacrifice. Kimahri will use machina, if machina can find Yuna.', "Yuna should make Yuna's decision.", 'Gagazet is Ronso land. Kimahri home.', 'Kimahri has no family.', 'But Kimahri not alone.', 'Sacred mountain Gagazet. Not change for one thousand years.', 'No. An unsent.', 'Biran and Yenke gone.', 'Biran is hero of Ronso. Yenke is powerful warrior.', 'Kimahri must fight. Kimahri must win.', 'The sacred Gagazet. First time Kimahri climbs.', 'Then I must prove my strength!', 'This time, I win. I will win!', 'Kimahri problem.', 'Kimahri crush enemies standing before.', 'Save some for Kimahri!', 'No ...', "You have angered Kimahri! The spirits of the Ronso will guide Kimahri's spear!", 'Yuna.', 'Kimahri knows. Kimahri go first. Yuna is safe. Kimahri protect.', 'Yuna needs Kimahri. Kimahri protect Yuna.', 'Yuna, no apologies.', 'Apology is running. Yuna never run away.', "Yevon's teachings.", 'No answer in the teachings, answers lie outside. Must know both sides to find answer.', 'Mika knows much. Find him, make him talk.', 'Kimahri doubts Mika welcomes us.', 'We cannot chase if we cannot see.', 'We must go to Bevelle.', "You keep walking path forward. Kimahri watch the rear. Because of you, Yuna still smiles. Thank you. Friends have saved Kimahri's life. Kimahri will treasure it. Kimahri is ready. Let us fight Sin.", 'On my honor as Ronso!', 'Sin still lives.
