Kimahri knows.', "You are Kimahri's friend.", "The Ronso were singing, too. Kimahri's ears never wrong. Kimahri felt friendship from somewhere inside Sin. There is no need for fear. Kimahri will go with you.", 'Yuna!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Oh, come on! You actually believe that rumor?', "Zanarkand, eh ... ? If you're going to bluff at all, say something a little more believable.", "You've got nerve to say you're from Zanarkand. Go home and relearn Yevon's teachings.", "You should go rest. You're gonna drown during the match if you're sleep-deprived."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I opened the store, but we can't serve anything because we don't have anything.", 'All the food and drinks are at the bottom of the ocean. Sin took them all.', "You're the one who saved my sister, right? That treasure box contains a token of my appreciation. Please accept my thanks.", "He's been like that ever since he returned from Operation Mi'ihen.", "I want to practice for the upcoming tournament, but I've been so busy that I haven't had any time.", "Those warrior monks ate everything in sight, then returned to Bevelle. They basically just ate and ran. What do they take us for? We'll bill the temple for all the food they took."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Thanks for saving me. Our house fell down ... but my big sister's here, so I'm real happy!", "Hey, are you a blitzer? Good luck! I'm rooting for you!", "My sister's the greatest. She plays blitzball and works at the same time.", "I'm gonna grow up to be a blitzer just like my sister!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I beat myself up all night for taking part in that disastrous operation. Then a monk told me that if I had time for remorse, I should spend it praying. He's right. It's my duty to pray for my departed men.", 'The monk gave me this, but I think you should have it.', 'I will pray for all my lost comrades.', "Guarding the temple is my duty. I'm trying to stay focused and not worry about anything else.", "Frankly, this isn't half as exciting as devising strategies against Sin. I wouldn't mind leading my old troops into battle right now.", "We're behind you all the way! Good luck! Hey, it's been a long time! How's it going? Traitors! Just kidding. Sorry about all that fuss.", "More and more people question the teachings these days. I only hope it doesn't lead to another tragedy like Operation Mi'ihen. The Crusaders defied the teachings, and look what happened to them! Once you're on the Farplane, there's no turning back!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['The Al Bhed Psyches all escaped harm. We are ready to play again!', 'Have care! There are fiend in all places!', 'I wonder, where will the airship go from here?', 'I want to be a top player. Many teams I want to try.', 'I do not run around in panic! Hope for the best, prepare for the worst!', 'I know it will not do to panic, but I do not know how to be calm!', 'Rikku and Yuna are in your hands.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Everyone was so pumped up for the tournament, but now because of Sin, well ... We players don't even feel up to practicing anymore.", "We may be short on practice, but we'll prove we 've got what it takes. We'll cheer up the whole island by bringing home the victory cup this year!", "We're off to Luca as soon as I finish this off.", "Just wait and see. We'll win for sure.", "I tried to dismantle that wrecked ship over there and haul it away, but ... She's so sturdy I couldn't get so much as a deck board off her! Hats off to that shipbuilder.", "Reconstruction of the town is nearly complete. All that's left is to fix that road over there.", "Repairs to the village are finally finished, but you can't say the place is back to normal yet.", 'I sang along with everyone else while Sin and the flying ship were battling it out–but man, was I scared. I mean, what if Sin came crashing down on top of us!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I can head the ball pretty good. Today's just a bad day, ya?", 'This is really weird, ya? I could do five in a row yesterday!', "I'm nowhere near Cap'n Wakka, but I can hold my own underwater, ya? It's just that ... I'm not so good with the ball.", "It true that the best players can even sleep underwater? Man, that's like ... superhuman, you know?", '(muttered) Hi, there.', '(lunge and fistpump) To do our best!', '(uncertainly) Victory ... (cheering) Victory! Victory! Victory! Yay!', "There's going to be six teams from all over Spira at the tournament.", "It's a rough setup. One loss and you're through, ya?", "The toughest team out there is the Goers, and the stadium's on their home turf!", 'Man, I wish we were half as popular as Yuna.', 'Should I practice kick passes too?', "Okay, I'll pretend I'm kicking with my hands!", 'Right on!', "I'm gonna sharpen my hand skills!", "(Working on righthand path) Tidus, watch your step! It's not safe this way.", 'Mm.', 'So this is the place remembered in honor of High Summoner Ohalland ... Makes you kind of nervous, ya?', "All these flames around the temple ... They've always burned strong, ever since High Summoner Ohalland's time.", "That was Bickson. He's a jerk, but a first-rate blitzer.", 'Why do we have to be on the same ship as those Lucans anyway?', "Wakka is busy right now. Maybe you shouldn't bother him.", "Let's pray we don't have to go against the Goers until the finals!", "Is Datto alright? It's right before the big game and all.", "That was one amazing shot you just did! They don't call you an ace for nothin'.", 'We were on the sphere!', 'We had to play the Goers in the first match last year.', "No lookin' back now, ya? We just wait for the game!", 'W-We play to win, ya?', 'The game starts in a few minutes. You sure you okay?', 'Are you okay?', "Let's get them Goers. Let's do it for Chappu!", 'Win!', "Cap'n!", 'Yeah!', 'Yeah!', "Shouldn't you heal up first?", "Cap'n ...", "It's not the same without you, man. Come back anytime, ya?", "We didn't do half bad, ya? Next time, the Goers are goners!", "So Operation Mi'ihen failed. Reminds me of when Chappu died.", "I wonder how Luzzu and Gatta are doin'? No one from Besaid has heard from them, either.", "The temple has pardoned the Crusaders. It's a little late for that, ya?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Lost my gang. Here you go. It's cold, ain't it?", "It's best that you don't go.", "(Now sitting on temple steps by monk) I'm hungry. No one's coming to pick me up. It's cold, ain't it?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['This is it. Too many goodbyes — people think twice about leaving.', '(Chuckles) We should go. Day will break soon.', 'Auron, could you stand closer to him?', 'Good. (Tips camera up to frame "Lake Macalania" sign) That should do it.', '(Nods) I suppose.', 'Auron!', "Hello, Yuna. I hope you are well. I wonder how old you are, now that you're watching this sphere. You must be very beautiful, like your mother. I wish I could see you. Oh, by the way ... Jecht and Auron send their regards. So far, our journey has been very entertaining. Of course, it is a hard journey, but I have no regrets. It is the path I have chosen. Yuna, when you have grown, you will have to find your own path. Do what you must do, the way you want to do it. Doors will always open themselves to those who do. Listen close, Yuna. Your future is yours to make. Live the way you want to. Whatever way that may be, you have your father's full support. Yuna, I will always be with you.", 'Thank you for your concern.', 'You knew this was to happen, my friend.', '(Chuckles) Auron, I am honored that you care for me so. But I have come to kill grief itself. I will defeat Sin, and lift the veil of sorrow covering Spira. Please understand, Auron.', 'Probably.', 'You can ask for them after I defeat Sin.', 'If I turn back, who will defeat Sin? Would you have some other summoner and his guardians go through this?', 'Jecht.', 'Sorry. I mean ... thank you.', "But there's always a chance it won't come back this time. It's worth trying.", 'Jecht?', 'Now, that looks like a fine place to live. Hmm ... Auron.', 'When this is over ... could you bring Yuna here? I want her to lead a life far away from this conflict.', 'Thank you, Auron. You are a good friend.', "(Laughter) Sorry. Well, let's go then.", 'Beyond it lies ... Zanarkand.', "I'm sorry.", 'Be careful, Jecht.', "She'll be all right. She's strong, like her mother was.", 'Working on your form?', 'Your son plays blitzball?', 'A giant fiend that attacks chocobos ...', 'Well, then ...', 'Auron, please. He did apologize. He knows he was wrong.', "You're sure?", 'You are the one they call Jecht, the man from Zanarkand, are you not?', "(Nods to Auron, then faces Jecht again) Ah. My apologies. I am Braska, a summoner. I've come to take you from this place.", 'Ahhaha ... That easy to see, was it? I soon leave on a pilgrimage ... to Zanarkand.', 'Mm. (Nods) I would like you to join us. It will be a dangerous trip. Yet, if we do reach Zanarkand ... my prayers will be answered, and you will be able to go home, we think. What say you?', 'Hm. So quick?', "Then it's settled.", 'What does it matter? No one truly believes that I, a fallen summoner wed to an Al Bhed ... could possibly defeat Sin. This is what they say. No one expects us to succeed.', "(Chuckles) Let's show them they're wrong. A fallen summoner, a man from Zanarkand, and a warrior monk, doomed to obscurity for refusing the hand of the priest's daughter. What delightful irony it would be if we defeated Sin!", 'Now, Jecht ... I am in your hands until we reach Zanarkand.', 'This is it. Too many goodbyes — people think twice about leaving.', '(Chuckles) We should go. Day will break soon.', 'Auron, could you stand closer to him?', 'Good. (Tips camera up to frame "Lake Macalania" sign) That should do it.', '(Nods) I suppose.', 'Auron!', 'Working on your form?', 'Your son plays blitzball?', 'A giant fiend that attacks chocobos ...', 'Well, then ...', 'Auron, please. He did apologize. He knows he was wrong.', "You're sure?", 'Oh, I was just ... thinking.', 'Are you all right?', 'Beyond it lies ... Zanarkand.', "I'm sorry.", 'Be careful, Jecht.', "She'll be all right. She's strong, like her mother was.", 'Now, that looks like a fine place to live. Hmm ... Auron.', 'When this is over ... could you bring Yuna here? I want her to lead a life far away from this conflict.', 'Thank you, Auron. You are a good friend.', "(Laughter) Sorry. Well, let's go then.", "Hello, Yuna. I hope you are well. I wonder how old you are, now that you're watching this sphere. You must be very beautiful, like your mother. I wish I could see you. Oh, by the way ... Jecht and Auron send their regards. So far, our journey has been very entertaining. Of course, it is a hard journey, but I have no regrets. It is the path I have chosen. Yuna, when you have grown, you will have to find your own path. Do what you must do, the way you want to do it. Doors will always open themselves to those who do. Listen close, Yuna. Your future is yours to make. Live the way you want to. Whatever way that may be, you have your father's full support. Yuna, I will always be with you."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Lady Summoner, I presume?', '(Salutes) I am Lucil, captain of the Djose Chocobo Knights.', 'There have been reports of a large fiend appearing in this area, with a taste for chocobos. Do take care, Summoner Yuna, if you are to rent any chocobos.', 'Good. We should get back to our rounds. Farewell.', "This mission requires our full attention. We've no time to waste! Understood?", 'Carry on.', 'What are you doing on this road?', 'I see. The Highroad ends over there. However, we have sealed off the area beyond for the duration of our operation here. You may ask the gate captain up ahead if you need to pass through. You must first go to the end of the Highroad in order to get back on the Newroad.', 'Sir! (Salute) Support units are in place. Mounted units have finished all exercises.', 'Just a few stragglers–nothing to worry about, sir.', 'No problems, sir.', 'Sir!', "We've been expecting you. Please proceed to the command center.", "The presence of a maester and a summoner is great for the troops' morale– myself included. Thank you for being here, my lady.", 'Depending on the way things turn out, we might suffer casualties. In such an event, we would be grateful if you could perform the sending, my lady.', 'We may have to fight here, as well. Stay alert.', 'All Crusaders in the vanguard are to assemble on the beach!', 'Lady Summoner! There you are! The command center is that way. Maester Kinoc is also there.', 'Yes. Please hurry, my Lady.', "Let's go!", 'Charge!', '(Salutes) Yuna, it is good to see you and your companions are well.', 'We escaped with our lives, but our troops were decimated.', 'We turned our backs on the teachings and cast away our faith. This ... this is our just reward.', 'So may died in vain ... It was a mistake.', 'Off so early? (Yevon bow) Lady Yuna, you must be exhausted after working so hard last night. Will you be okay?', '(Salute) Yes, first we cross the Moonflow, and then we head north in search of chocobos to replace those we have lost.', "(Shakes head, then salutes again) Lady Yuna, I wish you good fortune. Elma! Clasko! Let's go!", 'Please, we beg of you!', '(sigh) It is no good. We will have to find another way. We will find a ford where we can cross on foot.', "Where there's a will, there's a way.", 'Lady Yuna, it is good to see you made it through safely. And, if I may, congratulations on your betrothal.', '.', "We've reeceived several reports of summoners disappearing these last few days. Please be careful, my lady.", "When our assignment here is done we will be heading north. Hopefully we'll catch some chocobos and rebuild our unit.", "But I must say ... it's been a while. Maybe too long since we've had anything to celebrate.", 'This road leads to Bevelle. You should hurry to the temple in Macalania.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["What are you doing here? Didn't think we'd be able to handle it?", '(Doubletake) Who are you?', "(Offscreen) He's dead, okay? Dead!", "He does look a lot like Chappu. I was surprised, too, the first time I saw him. But no matter what he looks like, he isn't Chappu. You shouldn't have brought him here in the first place!", 'Excuses again?', "That's the sword you gave Chappu.", 'This is our journey ... We should leave together.', "(calls) You really don't need all that luggage.", "Clueless, aren't you? Good thing I'm here.", 'Spells of ice work well against fire fiends ... And ice fiends are weak against fire magic. You follow?', 'Lightning and water are opposed, just like fire and ice. This one here is a water fiend, which means ...', 'This is the sort of thing that can happen if you pick the wrong element.', "Uh, that was a bad example. This one's a water fiend, so fire and ice aren't very effective.", 'Take your time.', "Kimahri Ronso, of the Ronso tribe. He's learned the fiends' way of fighting.", 'Show us what your training has taught you, Yuna!', "I don't know who you are, or where you came from. If you interfere with Yuna's pilgrimage, we won't take it lightly.", '(Exasperated sigh) Great plan.', "Wakka's ... a bit lacking in the imagination department.", "The fin! That's where they're coming from.", "You truly are clueless. Are you sure it's just your memory that's the problem?", "The dead need guidance. Filled with grief over their own death, they refuse to face their fate. They yearn to live on, and resent those still alive. You see, they envy the living. And in time, that envy turns to anger, even hate. Should these souls remain in Spira, they become fiends that prey on the living. Sad, isn't it?", 'The sending takes them to the Farplane, where they may rest in peace.', 'Yuna chose her own path. She knew from the beginning what it meant. All we can do is protect her along the way. Until the end.', '(Nods slightly to Yuna, then throws hands in the air with a huff and leaves Tidus) Until she defeats Sin.', "You did very well! They've reached the Farplane by now. But ... (Strokes hair) no tears next time, hm?", "(To Tidus) Yuna's saying she wants you with us.", "We're all going to the temple anyway. Can't this wait till later?", 'Kimahri, why don\'t you use "Lancet" on it?', "Normally, it's a skill that weakens enemies and heals the user. But when a Ronso uses it, that Ronso can sometimes learn fiends' abilities.", 'Kids ...', 'Its tentacles absorb any spell cast at its body!', "Fiends. They fall from Sin's body, and are left behind in its wake.", '(Shakes head) Amazing. Simply amazing.', "You make up one theory after another, refusing to face the simple truth. Sin didn't take Chappu anywhere. Sin crushed him and left him on the Djose shore! Your brother won't just pop back.", "Oh, and one more thing. No matter how much you want it, no one can take Chappu's place. No one can replace Sir Jecht, for that matter. And there's no replacement for Lord Braksa, either. It's pointless to think about it, and sad.", 'I think Wakka needs to do a little more praying.', 'But first, the Cloister of Trials. Kimahri? Wakka? Ready?', "You're not a guardian yet.", 'Yuna will be the one to suffer the consequences!', 'The fayth are people who gave their lives to battle Sin. Yevon took their souls, willingly given from their still-living bodies.', "Now they live forever, trapped in statues. But when a summoner beckons, the souls of the fayth emerge once again. That's what we call an aeon.", 'The chamber beyond is a sacred place. Only summoners may enter.', "Well? Say something. You'll take responsibility?", 'And if not?', 'What? Just leaving him in Luca?', 'Yuna wants to make him a guardian.', 'And whose fault is that?', "Because he's Sir Jecht's son.", "It's hard to say, but Yuna seems to believe so.", '"Okay?" "Okay?" That\'s all you have to say?', "You're right, for once.", 'I wonder which is best ...', "Why don't you tell him he should?", "Become Yuna's guardian.", "Because Yuna can't.", 'Be discreet.', 'Apparently. He told Yuna as much.', 'I ... I was five then, so I remember mine a little.', 'Hm?', "I'm sorry. I need some time to think.", "Maester Mika is the leader of all the peoples of Spira. He's come all the way from Bevelle. The tournament is being held to honor his fifty years as Maester.", "It's crowded out there. Stay close.", 'Where in Spira have you been!?', "Yuna's been kidnapped by the Al Bhed Psyches. In exchange for her safe return, they want the Aurochs to lose.", "If they're only blitzball players, I doubt they'd do anything drastic. But we shouldn't take chances. Let's go get her.", "Wakka said the same thing. He'll take care of the game. We should go get Yuna. The Al Bhed boat is in dock 4. Let's go.", "Must be the Al Bhed's doing. Let's go the other way.", 'Ancient machina salvaged by the Al Bhed. They are mostly vulnerable to lightning.', 'The Al Bhed were expecting us.', "(Shakes head) He won't last. Wakka's always like that.", "Let's go.", "Let's go.", "It's probably out of power.", 'I hope you hurt them.', "Don't tell Wakka about Yuna's lineage. The thing about Wakka–he never had much love for the Al Bhed.", 'I thought I told you not to tell Wakka!', "Not the most ... graceful win. If it was Chappu, he'd still be standing.", '(Snarls) Excuse me?', "You don't want to finish that sentence.", "Please, don't tell anyone about Yuna's lineage.", 'I saw you floating there, on the sphere.', "You really gave it your all, didn't you?", "What's happening?", "Not really. We don't know where the fiends came from. Maester Mika is safe and sound, thanks to Maester Seymour. That's about it.", 'Sir Auron knows him, apparently. You were right. He did meet someone he knew.', 'But ... why?', "You're a real guardian now, so no mistakes. Understood?", 'The Calm is a time of peace. It comes after a summoner defeats Sin, and lasts until Sin reappears.', 'The use of machina is strictly forbidden by the Yevon priesthood.', 'This might be the last time we can rest like this.', 'To the chocobo corral!', 'Now! Hit it hard and we can push it back!', "Yuna, it's time to go.", 'Hmm ... I can only speculate.', 'Luzzu, no!', '(Sigh) Luzzu told me ... before we left.', 'Chappu ... He left the sword Wakka gave him in Besaid. And he fought with an Al Bhed machina weapon instead.', "(Whispers to Tidus) That's Wen Kinoc, one of the Four Maesters of Yevon. He leads the warrior monks and also commands the Crusaders.", "Anything could happen. Make sure you're ready for combat.", "I'll cast a spell at its head!", "You were in contact with Sin again. The toxin–are you okay? Yuna was worried about you. You should let her know you're all right.", 'Rest while you can. We leave soon.', 'First down the Moonflow to the Guado city of Guadosalam ... Then we cross the Thunder Plains to the temple of Macalania.', 'The Lightning Mushroom Rock. It only opens when a summoner is addressing the fayth.', "You should try to settle down. Yuna will be blamed if anything happens. Now we wait. This is also a guardian's duty.", 'No matter how dark the night, morning always comes. And our journey begins anew.', "Really, there's no rush ... Here, your hair.", 'Ah ... we called to you, but with all that snoring ...', 'We cross the Moonflow.', "I'm worried.", "I mean I'm worried about those summoners disappearing.", 'Confident.', 'This is the Moonflow.', 'The entire river glows, like a sea of stars.', "Riding a shoopuf isn't THAT much fun.", 'The merchants here are wily. Pick your shop well.', 'But the weight of the city caused the bridges to collapse, and it all sank to the bottom.', 'Yevon, it decides ... which machina we may use, and which we may not.', 'Or war will rage again.', 'They made weapons so powerful ... It was thought they could destroy the entire world.', 'The war ended ... and our reward ... was Sin.', 'Only as bad as their users.', 'Are you hurt?', "I wonder ... Didn't Kimahri's clansman say something ... about summoners ... disappearing?", "You're right.", "Looks like we're stuck here for a while.", 'Oh!', 'Uh, Wakka ...', 'Right. Sorry, Wakka.', "(Examining Seymour's portrait, among others) These are the past leaders of the Guado.", "Don't you know? The last leader ... (Glances to portrait on far side of room) Maester Jyscal wed a human woman. She was Seymour's mother.", "There's no temple here in Guadosalam, see? Summoners usually just pass through on their way elsewhere.", '(Snaps) What?', "You'd rather I say nothing, then?", "Well ... There are many things I do not know. Your Zanarkand is one of those things. I suppose I can't say what I think either way. Still, be careful. You shouldn't tell other people.", "Why don't you eat something?", "Yuna, the high summoner's daughter. Seymour, the leader of the Guado. Married in the name of Yevon, overcoming the barriers of race. It would give Spira something cheery to talk about, for a change.", "Go on, we'll be right behind you.", "I'm not even sure what I'm saying.", "Hmm ... That's a possibility.", 'What, me? With Wakka?', "Getting along isn't enough. Not even close.", "You'd do well to remember that. Knowing a bit about women might come in handy some day.", "I won't be forgetting either.", 'Goodbye, Chappu. You always said I looked grumpy. But those were the happiest days of my life.', "Why don't you try calling someone? All you have to do is think about them.", 'Did I miss something?', 'He is Lord Jyscal no more. Send him now!', 'I would think that he was sent once ... but he stayed on Spira. Something, a powerful emotion could have bound him to this world. Such things happen.', 'What?', "As long as the pilgrimage continues, either way's fine.", 'People marry for many reasons.', "Sometimes marriage doesn't require love, you know? Defeat Sin, and bring joy to the people of Spira. Get married, and bring joy to the people of Spira. For Yuna, they're just two ways down the same road. All you need is determination. If you have that, you don't need love.", 'Listen. If Yuna gets married, then I ...', 'Yes. If she is to marry, I would want her to marry for love.', 'But ... If Yuna said she wanted to marry the one she loves, I would have to object.', 'I know.', "I've talked enough about that.", "I'm sorry, just forget about it.", "I shouldn't have to say this, but don't fall in love with her.", "That's fine, then.", 'I see. But ... you must keep your feelings inside, until the pilgrimage is over.', "Interesting. I suppose I could add you to my list. I wish you good luck, little boy. You're going to need it.", "She's not appearing.", 'None of your business.', "(Sigh) No ... it's not your fault. (Addresses pyreflies) Why aren't you here? I need to be alone right now.", 'See the lightning rod towers? The lightning is drawn to them ... hopefully.', 'Meaning we should avoid wide, open areas.', 'Stop kidding around.', "It's not like her.", "Yuna looked preoccupied. Was it because of Jyscal? Don't tell Rikku, but we leave as soon as Yuna's better.", 'But ... it can be effective. Magic is effective against marine fiends.', 'You should learn some spells, too.', 'Hmm ... Maybe later.', "We're not through the Thunder Plains yet, so be prepared, all right? Did you two have a fight?", 'Here?', '(Shakes head) I thought so.', 'Wait, is it ... Is it because of Lord Jyscal?', 'It absorbs all spells except its one weakness!', "Yuna's really quiet. Sitting here like this, you really get to thinking.", "We knew you'd be upset.", 'Just think of this as an opportunity to learn more about the Al Bhed.', "You've done nothing to apologize for.", "I hope that you're not too mad at Wakka.", '(Sigh) Thank you.', "Me? She's ... fun to be with.", "Well, I can tell she's not a bad person.", "Well, there's more to it than that.", "Wakka doesn't like the Al Bhed because of his brother Chappu.", 'What?', "I can't say that I know, but why?", 'Sin is the punishment for, and the incarnation of, crimes we have committed.', "There's no need to know, so no one asks. You run or you fight. That is really all you can do. There's no sense brooding over it.", '(Chuckles) You really do come from a world where there is no Sin, like you say.', "Come on, Wakka. Let's at least hear him out.", 'If he is truly at fault, it must be done.', "We're under the lake ice, aren't we? Look. That's the bottom of the temple. We've fallen a long way. So now we're the traitors that killed a maester.", 'In exchange for marriage?', 'Sir Auron!?', 'But still, we have transgressed and must face our punishment.', "You're too edgy. Listen to the hymn and calm down.", 'The fayth.', "Of course it can. Don't be a fool. Say, isn't the ground shaking?", 'The singing stopped.', 'The toxin! Watch out!', 'Are you all right?', '(Arrives) Are you all right?', "Haven't found them yet. We're supposed to stay in one place if we get split up.", 'Gone ... (Shakes head) Some guardian I am.', "Of all the places ... Let's go!", 'A war? Between Yevon and the Al Bhed?', "Rikku, what is the Summoners' Sanctum?", 'It was just ... too hard to say.', "Don't you think we tried to stop her? She follows ... her heart.", 'How?', 'This is tough on all of us.', 'And you still use it?', "We're powerless as long as we're on this ship.", "No matter what happens, Yuna won't give up her pilgrimage.", 'The Palace of St. Bevelle. Heart of Yevon.', "It's called a wedding dress.", 'The city of Bevelle is built on the water. There may be underwater fighting. You or Rikku should study your magic, just in case. Seymour is one of the dead now. Odd. Why does Maester Mika allow the unsent to walk free?', 'The guardian wyrm, Evrae. The great sacred beast– protector of Bevelle!', "The Calm Lands. Long ago, the high summoners fought Sin here. The road ends here. Beyond, there're no towns, no villages. Only endless plains.", 'Father Zuke!', 'Father, you came all the way here just to tell us this?', 'Thank you, Father.', 'Until half a year ago, he was a summoner. Wakka and I were his guardians.', 'He gave up halfway. Here, on this plain. Now, he is a monk at the Bevelle temple.', "This is my third pilgrimage as a guardian. Father Zuke was my second. And my first, well ... It ended here, too. I've never been to the lands beyond. Mt. Gagazet towers to the north, and Zanarkand lies beyond that.", 'That way leads down into the valley.', 'The fayth is inside. As are the fiends.', 'They say it was stolen from a temple long ago.', "It is ... It's you, is it not, Lady Ginnem? Forgive me. I was too young.", 'There is no human left in you now, is there?', 'Very well, then. Allow me to perform my last duty to you. My last as your guardian.', "Strange. I thought it would be sadder, somehow. Maybe I've gotten used to farewells.", "Wakka, I hope you're right.", 'Yuna, the fayth is inside. Go do what you came to do.', 'Lord Kelk Ronso, if I may. Have you not also turned your back on Bevelle?', "Yuna's ... grown stronger.", "That's why she's strong. She's still pressing forward. When weak people are driven they can't go far before they break. She keeps going forward, because she is strong.", "Yuna has grown strong. And I ... All I can do is try and keep up with her. Let's get ready for the climb.", 'These mark the graves of summoners and guardians who failed.', "Summoners that die up here ... aren't sent to the Farplane.", 'Who would send them? They die alone.', "Many have become fiends, and they may want Yuna's company.", "(Sigh) You're right.", 'All this way, only to fail. It must have been tough.', 'Yuna!', "You'd fight your own father?", 'Who wields power on this scale, and what could they be calling?', 'You okay?', "If anything should happen in the water, we're relying on you three. If it gets dangerous, pull out quick.", 'She said "Lady Yocun," didn\'t she? Wait! She guarded High Summoner Yocun?', 'If one of us has to become a fayth ... I volunteer.', "If you want everything, you'll end up with nothing.", "This ... this cannot be! The teachings state that we can exorcise Sin with complete atonement! It's been our only hope all these years!", 'You can always run.', 'My thoughts exactly.', 'We need to sit and think this through. There has to be a way!', 'The Hymn is the key.', 'Sir Jecht likes the Hymn of the Fayth, correct?', 'Sin ... violence incarnate, listening peacefully.', "Let me say it. If we attack Sin head-on, we've little chance of winning. However, if he hears the Hymn of the Fayth, he will become docile.", "Well, I guess it's all or nothing.", "I'm still not the person I wanted to become, not yet. I'll come back to let you know how things went. I hope I'll bring back ... good news.", 'Seven hundred years ago ... a monk who defied the teachings was sentenced here.', 'Just what does he think he can get away with?', 'Lady Yunalesca also mentioned him.', "We'll be bringing a new Calm. One that will last forever. This will be a battle unmatched in the thousand years since Sin's birth. Spira without Sin ... hmm. Why is it so hard to imagine? Afterwards–after we defeat Sin–promise you'll stay with Yuna.", 'A singing ship in the sky.', "Well? Let's go!", 'Yes, I can hear the Hymn, too.', 'A day with you is never dull!', "But it has weakened. I'm sure of it.", "I think it's a little early to start celebrating.", "Let's go. Just you and me.", 'You\'ve proven yourself as a guardian. Maybe even as the best. You know, your meeting Yuna was really quite ... Can\'t say "Praise be to Yevon" anymore, can we?', 'Here it comes!', 'What are you talking about?', "Yuna, it's time.", 'Seven hundred years ago ... a monk who defied the teachings was sentenced here.', "Let's go!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Ah, the one from the sea!', "After surviving your run-in with Sin, 'twould be a shame if something happened now.", "If Sin's nearby, it'll attack the island for sure. But it hasn't. I wonder why?", 'Sin! The toxin! Gatta, tell him who we are!', "Well, we've steered Sin away from towns many times! And that's all we can do. Nobody's ever been able to defeat it. Our mission as Crusaders is to protect the temples, towns, villages, and people of Spira.", 'It does seem rather bad ...', 'We could just tell you, but I think it better for you to try and remember. Go pray at the temple. Perhaps Yevon will help you regain your memory.', "We've been excommunicated from Yevon. We must go, now. Everything is riding on our next ... our last battle!", "I'm not at liberty to talk about our plan.", "If people think you're with us, you'll be excommunicated, too! Some things you're better off not knowing. Take it from me.", "The fiend before us is Ochu, Lord of the Wood! We've had trouble with this one before. Remember, discretion is the better part of valor.", 'The Ochu is no garden-variety fiend. We could throw a hundred Crusaders at it and still lose.', 'Ochu poison is a surefire way to get to the Farplane, and fast.', 'Only the Lord of the Wood could fall asleep after a battle like that. Let it go. Save your strength for the next battle.', 'A summoner and her guardians. Very impressive!', "We'll get our chance soon enough.", "Do your best, kid. Wakka's counting on you.", 'It might not mean much, but good luck in the tournament.', 'Best to let him sleep.', "Well, you're looking in the wrong place. There aren't many people here.", "We'd like to, but we're waiting for some couriers.", "Hmm, they're late ... Wanna ditch the courier and go watch the game?", 'Ha.', 'See what I mean? We might be a little late, but we will go watch you play.', 'Congratulations, Wakka!', 'It was close, Wakka.', "Yes, ma'am! Apologies, ma'am!", 'See? Keep your head down, say "sir" a lot, and you\'ll do fine.', "Hey, Yuna. Even though Yevon rejected us ... we still believe in you. That won't ever change.", 'This is the last of them.', "Wait around. We'll have Sin beaten in no time!", 'Order are orders.', 'Guarding the command center is important too, you know.', 'But I came all the way from Besaid to fight Sin, sir!', "I know, but an order's an order. To your post, Crusader.", 'They let you through, huh?', "They still need some time to get them ready. Our job is to keep Sin at bay till they're done.", "Wakka ... I might not get another chance to say this. It's about your brother.", "I'm the one who convinced him ... to enlist.", "I'm sorry.", 'Chappu also said to me ... That being with your girl is good ... But keeping Sin far away from her is better.', '(Chuckles) She hit me too.', "That's my cue.", 'So you can hit me more?', 'I have to, Yuna.', 'Hey.', "Gatta, he's ... he's dead. He was a good fighter. He just wasn't lucky enough.", "Ah, damn it! He was young! He pushed his luck! What was he thinking–going up there in the front lines like that? He should've stayed back with command! Damn it! Damn it all!", "Y-You don't know what it's like!", "(Slumps) I'm sorry.", 'Rest?', 'I ... I guess so.', '(snorts) Right.', 'This is all punishment for turning from Yevon ...', 'I suppose this is farewell, then.', "I'm leaving ... back to Besaid. I can't stay here eating the temple's bread forever. I'm one of the only Crusaders still here.", "You're leaving, I hear. Farewell, I hope we meet again.", 'Watching for fiends! We Crusaders must protect the village. Even if we cannot defeat Sin, we do what we can.', 'Then you should pray before you go. All who leave the island pray for safe passage over there. Gatta always refused, though.', 'Eh?', '(Chuckles) Well, I guess you have the spirit. Good luck.', 'Even should the temple forsake us, we will do our duty. We are the shield that guards this land.', "I can't believe they're calling Lady Yuna a traitor ...", 'Calling Lady Yuna a traitor? There must be some mistake! Everyone in Besaid thinks so. As long as Sin remains, so does our duty.', 'They say a flying ship gave Sin a good chase. Never let your guard down! Sin is the most evil of foes. All we can do is praty that this ship of the skies can defeat Sin.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['This is a statue of Lord Mi\'ihen. Eight centuries ago, he founded a legion known today as the Crusaders. In just a few short years after their founding, their ranks grew throughout Spira. The maesters of Yevon feared an uprising and accused them of rebellion. So Lord Mi\'ihen walked along this very road to go face their charges and refute them. He succeeded in winning the maesters\' trust, and his legion became an arm of the Yevon clergy. It was then that Yevon gave them the name "Crusaders," which they have kept ever since. And the rest is history.', 'Although this is a highroad, fiends do appear. Be on your guard!', 'Do you know what those ruins are from?', "Correct. A city most ancient! A terrible testament to Sin's power. I tremble every time I see them. Compared to Sin, humans are mere mudpuppies!", "A good reply. I am relieved to hear you say that, m'lady summoner.", "Where are my manners? I am Maechen, a scholar. At your service, m'lady. I am on a journey, studying the history of our world, Spira, seeking its stories and secrets ... .", "My travels have taken me to many places, and I am troubled by what I have seen. Fragile smiles on people's faces crumbling at the mere mention of Sin. They are counting on you, m'lady. Give them a reason to rejoice once more.", "Ah, Lady Yuna's guardians, I presume?", "Mr. Rin's shops are all over Spira. They are quite convenient when you're on the road.", 'A safe journey to you!', 'Would you like to hear about the Highroad?', 'Hmm ... pity.', "We are currently travelling a part of the Mi'ihen Highroad called the Newroad. Naturally, that suggests that there is, or was, an Oldroad. The road that runs below this Newroad is the original Mi'ihen Highroad. Hence, the road that Lord Mi'ihen walked is not this road, but the Oldroad. The Newroad was built to replace the Oldroad destroyed by Sin five hundred years ago. But sometimes, standing on the Oldroad and reminiscing about the past can be a pleasurable pastime.", 'Would you like to hear a bit about the wondrous shoopuf?', 'Pity.', "Very well! There are many things we do not know about the shoopuf. For example, what does it eat? It eats nothing! The water it sucks through its schnoz somehow supports its considerable size. Some theorize it eats teeny-weeny waterborne organisms. And that, as they say, is that. Perhaps you'd like to hear a bit about the Hypello, hmm?", 'Pity.', "These shoopuf handlers belong to a race of water-dwellers known as the Hypello. They may be slow on land, but in the water they're quick as silvery fish! You'd think they'd make admirable players of blitzball. But their lackadaisical disposition draws them to less strenuous pastimes. And that, as they say, is that. I believe I've said all there is to say.", 'Care to hear about the Farplane or the pyreflies?', 'Pity. Suit yourself.', "Ahem! The Farplane's the place where pyreflies born from a sending gather. They appear in the shape of people who've died and gone to the Farplane. Quite the phenomenon; how I wish I understood it more fully! The Al Bhed have a theory, you know. They say the pyreflies are just reacting to visitors' thoughts and dreams. But only the dead appear on the Farplane. No image of the living has ever been seen. It's a great mystery! But maybe ... Maybe the dead leave a bit of themselves in the hearts of the living. And that little bit borrows the pyreflies' power for their paranormal performance! Or maybe not. Who knows? And that, as they say, is that.", 'Ahem! They may be called "pyreflies" but they aren\'t really "flies," you see. They\'re those lights you see whenever a fiend dies. The little fellows are responsible for a few fantastic phenomena. Visions of the past, spheres, fiends– these are all the pyreflies\' doing. In fact ... pyreflies have something to do with aeons, too. The dreams of the fayth reach through the spirit of the summoner ... And that which is unreal becomes real for all to see! Or maybe not. Who knows? And that, as they say, is that.', "Can't get enough? Like to hear it one more time?", 'Well, hello there. Would you like to hear about this place?', 'Pity.', 'Very well, let me tell you about the Crossing. A long time ago, this place was a traveller\'s nightmare. "Plains of lightning, plains of thunder, those who cross are torn asunder." Or ... so they used to say. Then a name by the name of Bilghen appeared. Using machina, he built towers that served as lightning rods across the plains. Finally, travellers were able to cross in safety. Bilghen was building that tower over there ... when he was struck and killed by lightning. Bilghen was an Al Bhed. Our history books never mention him. Take care, and farewell.', "I've heard Lady Yuna is to wed Maester Seymour. It is great news. I'd like to congratulate her. But ... it is a pity. I'd hoped Lady Yuna would defeat Sin and bring the Calm to Spira.", 'Ah! That is also great news! Her resolve is admirable!', 'Would you like to hear about Macalania?', 'Pity.', "Lake Macalania is frozen over all through the year. It stays frozen even on the hottest of days. It is said that the temple's fayth is the cause of this fantastic phenomenon! And that is all for today.", 'Hopefully I can be present at the wedding. It is not every day that one can attend such a joyous event.', 'What is all that ruckus outside?', 'Perhaps you would like to know a bit about these plains?', 'What a pity.', "Mm-hm. As you know, these plains were once a battlefield. A great battle between Bevelle and Zanarkand, a melee of machina! That war left this place a barren, lifeless land. Then, time passed. The summoners took note of this uninhabited land. Great battles could be fought here, with no harm to the common folk. Perfect for the final battle with Sin, as it were. Summoners wait here, ready to perform the Final Summoning. Ah, to know what they must feel! In any case, when Sin is defeated here, the Calm will visit Spira once more. That's why this place is now known as the Calm Lands. Exactly who dubbed it so is unknown. And that, as they say, is that. Oh dear, I almost forgot to tell you something. There's a chasm, a great rend in the earth, in these parts. A scar from High Summoner Gandof's bitter battle with Sin, four hundred years past. Like to hear about this place once more?", 'Shall I tell you about the Spira of days long past, eh?', 'Hmph. Suit yourself.', 'There is a legend, you know. Just before the horrible Sin appeared ... a terrible war raged between Bevelle and Zanarkand. When the armies of Bevelle attacked Mount Gagazet, they heard a song echoing across the snowy slopes. "\'Tis a song from an otherworld," they said. The soldiers panicked and ran. And then, as if to pursue the retreating armies, Sin appeared! Some time later, scouts from Bevelle braved the mountain. On the other side, they witnessed the ruins that had been Zanarkand. The city destroyed. Not a single soul left standing. Gone! In its place, a multitude of the fayth had gathered on Gagazet. They were singing a song. It\'s the song we now call the "Hymn of the Fayth." And that, as they say, is that. Well ... maybe not all of it.', 'Would you like to hear the rest?', 'Hmph. Suit yourself.', "Rumors flew in Bevelle about Sin's sudden appearance. They said that the people of Zanarkand became the fayth, that they had called Sin. And that the man responsible ... was none other than the summoner Yevon, ruler of Zanarkand! Yes, the lord father of Lady Yunalesca. On the eve of Zanarkand's destruction, Lady Yunalesca ... had fled to safety with her husband, Zaon. Later, the two used the Final Summoning to defeat Sin. Yet the people of Bevelle still feared Yu Yevon. It was to quell his wrath that they revered him, and first spread his teachings. And so were born the temples of Yevon. I suppose it's possible Yunalesca had planned it that way from the start! A fair trade, she defeats Sin in exchange for her lord father's honor. Of course, there's no proof. No, the facts are lost in the mists of time. And who'd admit Yevon was an enemy of Bevelle? You can bet the temples had a hand in covering that one up! And that, as they say, is that.", 'Like to hear more, would you?', 'Hmph. Suit yourself.', "Let me tell you about the Hymn of the Fayth. It was once a Zanarkand song, sung in defiance of Bevelle! Of course, the Yevon clergy of Bevelle forbade it. Then, as these things often go, those who disliked Yevon began to sing it. The Al Bhed, for instance. The Hymn of the Fayth became the symbol of defiance against Yevon. Yevon could do nothing but capitulate. They lifted the ban on the song, and spread a new story. They said the hymn was a song sung to soothe the souls of the dead. And so saying, they took the song and made it scripture. That's why today, the hymn is sung all over Spira. You could say that, though Zanarkand is gone from this world, it lives on in the song. Aaaah, but look at the time. I've rambled on again. I do love stories, you see. Well, I owe you my gratitude for hearing this old scholar out.", 'Like to hear about this place once more?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["And I'm Maroda. I'm guarding my big brother here.", 'Isaaru!', 'Our itinerary just keeps slipping. We should be climbing the slopes of Mt. Gagazet by now.', "I keep telling 'im, the more time we waste, the farther we'll fall behind the other summoners.", 'I heard it from those Crusaders. Seems that summoners have been going out on pilgrimage and just ... disappearing.', "Sorry I don't know more, but ... watch your back. Ain't much future for a guardian without a summoner, eh?", "We're talking about doing your job as a guardian!", "Hey, I'm not looking forward to my brother dying when this is all over. If only there was some way of doing it without anyone dying.", "Easier said than done. If we had all the time in the world, yeah, we'd think of something. And while we were thinking, Sin would kill us all. Spira doesn't have that time.", "The Al Bhed caught up to us in Besaid. They grabbed Pacce, so we had to do what they said. We needed a break, anyway. Pacce was pretty tired. He should never have come on the pilgrimage, little kid like that. Still, he does pretty good for his size. He's gonna be something someday. Hey, you know where this ship's headed?", 'Let him sleep, man.', 'Be careful!', "Hold there! This bridge is closed. Bevelle is off limits by the temple's decree. No one may enter.", '(Scolding) Pacce ...', "(To Tidus) At least, that's what they say. The temple's falling apart with all four maesters gone. They're afraid of riots, so they're turning everyone away. With our brother in the middle ...", "They came crying to him to stay in Bevelle, to protect the temple and all that. And you know our brother. It's not in him to refuse.", 'Of course not! Geez ...', "(To Tidus) Long story short ... You'll only find trouble in Bevelle. I'd stay out for your own safety.", "That whole bit about Yuna being a traitor's just some Al Bhed rumor, I hear. I just can't believe it. I mean, the Al Bhed helped us out! Wait all you want. Bevelle's gates are closed."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Kilika Temple is the temple of fire. Even the Cloister of Trials is engulfed in flames. Those who disobey the precepts and enter unsanctioned may forfeit their lives.', 'I was the captain of the Kilika Beasts in my youth. After Lord Ohalland took me under his wing, I followed the ways of Yevon.', 'We have asked the Crusaders to help patrol the temple, since the warrior monks have left. However, with so few of them, I do wonder if they will be able to fend off the fiends. Has the maester abandoned all the temples throughout Spira?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Ah, Lady Summoner. Yes, just over that way.', 'Welcom to Rin Travel Agency! We have a wide selection of quality merchandise to choose from.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["The Crusaders were in charge of guarding the stadium up until last year. But they're all busy preparing for the operation now. So this year, the citizens have taken up security posts.", 'I am relieved the grand maester is safe. We owe it all to Maester Seymour.', "Should I stay a Crusader, or follow a different path? I wanted to discuss this with someone on the Farplane, but maybe I shouldn't ...", "It's my future, so I need to make my own decisions.", "Forget about going to Guadosalam. It's so quiet, you'll go crazy. Rookie Crusaders are training somewhere in the Calm Lands, waiting for us to regroup.", "Seems like all the Guado want to go to the Farplane. What will become of the Crusaders once Sin's gone?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Welcome. What can I do for you?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["It's called endurance training. Stay out of my way. What do you want? I'll face you in the sphere pool soon enough.", "Luca's tournament was completely upstaged by Seymour's aeon. And by showing support for the excommunicated Crusaders, Seymour's popularity is growing fast.", "First a tribe, then a temple, and now ... a bride. Everything just falls into Seymour's lap.", 'Now that Seymour is dead, no one knows who will rise to take his place. That means that I still have a chance. Once I lead the Guado Glories to victory, I will become the next lord here. Until then, the Farplane cannot have me! Whatever it takes, I will live to see that day. No one will lord over the Guado but me! Mwahahaha.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Nothing beats blitz! I wish you luck.', 'I do not know a thing! I swear to you!', 'The Al Bhed had nothing to do with that fiend attack. That is the truth!', 'Many Al Bhed lost their lives in the operation.', 'I will not ride the airship. I get airsick easily.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I saw your rallying cry on the sphere. Heheh, best of luck to you.', "Nice work out there. Now I know you're not all talk.", 'I really enjoyed your awesome moves! I hope I get to see you play more often.', "Hey, when are you playin' next? I really want to see you again.", 'A flying ship, huh? What will they think of next?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['We need blitz to cheer our people after the loss of Home, you see?', 'I will not die in this place! I fear no fiend! Come, and I will fight!', 'I must train or the airship will rob me of my muscles!', 'The age of the temples is past. Now comes the age of machina!', 'Elder Cid has great courage! I must learn to be like him.', 'When the time comes, I will fight, Sin! Here is my best shot!', 'How was it inside Sin? Many fiend there, I think.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Yeah! Once we win the tournament, this will be my victory pose!', 'Yeah! Teamwork and trust are key elements for both guardians and blitzers!', 'You sure are taking it easy. The opening match is about to start, you know.', 'Yeah! Once we win the tournament next year, this will be my victory pose!', "Yeah! When the ship comes flying by, I'm going to cheer it on like this!", "Yeah! When the Calm comes, this is how I'm going to celebrate!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["We Guado help the warrior monks patrol the roads beyond. Why wouldn't we do all we can for the good of Spira?", "Someday when the Crusaders regroup, we'll want them to help us, too.", 'If the Al Bhed strike, I will arm myself and fight alongside my brethren.', 'Some advice from one blitzer to another Stay away from Guadosalam.', 'We Guado have lost our purpose. No one knows what chaos may ensue.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Aurochs are true warriors. Aurochs deserve mighty horns.', 'Ronso Fangs want to play more teams to hone blitz skills.', 'The Crusaders stand strong once more. We admire their fortitude.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Oooh, them's fascinatin' clothes you're wearing! (Walks over and inspects) Yewh! Filthy, filthy! These won't sell or me name's not O'aka! Don't look like you got much money either. I've no business with ye. Outta me way!", "O'aka XXIII, merchant extraordinaire!", "Don't know me? Well, not many do, not yet.", "But someday, the name O'aka will be spoken all over Spira!", "Say, lad, you wouldn't have a bit o' Gil to lend?", "You're really gonna give me X Gil?", "I guess it pays to ask! Thank ye kindly, lad! Fine seed money for the O'aka merchant empire! Much obliged, lad! I'll be sure to pay ye back!", "(Disgusted noise) Should've expected as much.", 'Eh, it figures.', 'Have you got some to lend?', "They ask a fortune for rags in Besaid. And Kilika, well ... Me business is in shambles! What's an O'aka to do, I ask ye!", 'Mind spotting me some Gil again, lad?', 'Right. Figures.', "(Disgusted noise) Should've expected as much.", "The stores at the stadium are closed during the tournament. But I'm always open for business!", "The people here are so into the game, they don't even look at what they're buying! Gotta love blitz, eh?", "The people here are so into the game, they don't even look at what they're buying! Gotta love blitz, eh?", 'Have you got some to lend?', "Hey, lad. I appreciate yer offer, but ye ain't got enough Gil.", 'Blimey, lad! Will ye actually lend me X Gil?', "Welcome to O'aka's!", "Coming down to the Oldroad was a mistake ... Ye can't run a business with no customers! Say, can I interest you in something?", 'Spare some change, lad? Yes. Ye really gonna lend me X gil? No. It figures.', "Sure are a lot of Crusaders about. Wonder what they're up to? Welcome to O'aka's!", 'Good day, lad! Sneaked past the guards, I did!', 'Be makin\' a fortune with "Operation Mi\'ihen" prices! But you, lad, you get a discount! I owes ya one, eh?', "Welcome to O'aka's!", "Monopoly's a great thing! Things are sellin' no matter what the price! Oops! Sorry, I forgot. Welcome to O'aka's!", 'I made a bundle with the operation prices. But the way it turned out, they deserved a better deal. I guess the summoners are our only hope. Huh? You wanna buy something?', "O'aka, at your service!", "O'aka, at your service!", 'Ohhh!', 'Thank ye.', "I tell ye, these Guado merchants are shrewd! Rippin' off the pilgrims that come to visit the Farplane! Listen, you watch that they don't get you, too! Me, ye can trust! More than the Guado, at least. What do ye say?", "Welcome! Holiday prices on all items in celebration of Maester Seymour Guado's wedding!", 'Too expensive, ye think?', 'How about this?', "I'll go with these prices for a while!", "Welcome to O'aka's!", "Curse that Rin for taking up a place like this! He'll be rich by tomorrow all on account of this celebration thing! Hmm? What? You buyin' somethin' from me?", 'Great! I knew I could count on you, lad!', "Should've expected as much.", "Welcome to O'aka's!", "You need somethin' for the big rescue, eh? I've got just the thing! Eh? you want something else?", "Hurray for Maester Seymour's wedding!", 'Oh, I hear Lady Yuna is still going to continue her journey, ah? I wonder if that means she and Maester Seymour will fight Sin together? Just like Lady Yunalesca and Lord Zaon!', "(Facepalm) You've really done it now! Wanna buy something, just in case? You be careful.", 'You can annoy Auron by trying to re-enter Macalania Temple ...', 'Hello, there!', "Nah, those monks are pushovers, I tell ye! I'll fleece any priest, or my name's not O'aka!", 'No problem! Anything for a customer, eh?', "I-It's nothing.", "Wantz has got all the good stuff. O'aka XXIII's retiring!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I'm Pacce. Pleased to meet you.", "Awww, it's so pretty ...", "What? What? Whatcha all talkin' 'bout?", "What? What? Whatcha all talkin' 'bout?", "Hey, I'm doing good! Right, big brother?", 'Oh ... what?', 'Be right there!', 'See ya!', 'Hey, um, what\'s "sacrificed"? The Al Bhed said summoners were being "sacrificed." That summoners shouldn\'t have to do a pilgrimage ...', "Don't worry! We'll guard this area!", "Everyone's in mourning since Maester Mika died ... And it's been morning [sic] for days now!", 'Oh, I guess our pilgrimage is done, then, huh?', "Isaaru sends his regards to Lady Yuna. And ... he says he's sorry, too. I heard something funny the other day. If a flying ship sings, we're supposed to sing along! And they say that will beat Sin!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Say, you play for the Besaid Aurochs. You're Tidus, right? I saw you at the tournament. Let's blitz sometime. Those fiends really made a mess. Some of my teammates were badly hurt.", "Aren't you headed to Macalania? Better not keep them waiting. Lord Seymour may be cool, but Tromell's got quite a temper, you know. Come back after the wedding. We'll swap blitz stories!", "Our captain is aiming for bigger goals now. He says he'll take the helm of the Guado! I wonder if he's really serious. How much Guado life would change with a blitzer in charge ..."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Wait! What if it is human?', 'I forbid it! We bring it with us.', '!', 'He said you can stay if you make yourself useful.', 'Oh, almost forgot!', "We found some ancient ruins right beneath us. It's not active now, but there should still be some power left. We're gonna go down there and activate it ... and then we should be able to salvage the big prize!", "Okay! Let's get to work!", "We'll go as soon as you're ready!", "Hey! (Offers canteen) It's 'cause you eat too fast!", 'Hey!', 'Rikku.', "I didn't get a chance to! Everyone thought oui were a fiend.", "We're Al Bhed. Can't you tell?", "Wait. You're not an Al Bhed-hater, are you?", 'Where are you from?', 'Did you hit your head or something?', 'Oh, right ... Do you remember anything before that?', 'You were near Sin.', "Don't worry, you'll be better in no time. They say your head gets funny when Sin is near. Maybe you just had some kind of dream?", "Because of Sin's toxin, yeah.", 'Yeah, there is no Zanarkand anymore. Sin destroyed it a thousand years ago. So ... no one plays blitzball there.', 'You said ... You play blitzball?', 'You know, you should go to Luca. Someone might know who you are, or you might find someone you recognize.', "(wanders around a bit, then pats his shoulder) Okay, leave it to me! I'll get you to Luca, promise!", "(laughs) You'd rather stay here?", "Okay, I'll go tell the others. Wait here.", "Oh, and one thing. Don't tell anyone you're from Zanarkand, okay? Yevon says it's a holy place. You might upset someone.", 'Hm.', '(Running up) Hey!', "You said you'd go with me!", 'I thought Wakka told you not to get any ideas?', "Yeah, so you're coming with me!", "That's the spirit!", 'Ah! I thought I was done for, back there.', 'Terrible!', 'You beat me up, remember?', 'Mm-hm. That really hurt, you know. You big meanie!', "Nuh-uh. It's not exactly what you think.", "Pleased to meet you! I'm Rikku!", 'Girls only! Boys please wait over there!', 'Um ... No good?', 'A hundred percent! So, anyway ... Can I?', 'Mm-hm!', "Righto! Then I'll just have to be the merriest!", 'Rikku, at your service!', "Oooh! A treasure chest! I wonder what's inside? (swipe) Ya-hoo!", "You should know, I'm scary when I'm mad! I'm gonna use that item I just got on you! You'll be sorry!", "I can combine items and use them like this. It's not that tough, really.", "Twist our arms why don't ya!", 'Ah, I almost forgot!', 'What would you do without me?', 'I wonder what smells so nice!', "(Behind buffet, talking with mouth full) Mmmm! This is good! Guado sure know how to eat! Gee, I wonder what all this is for. It's exciting!", 'Wow! Your face is beet red!', 'You could always just quit your pilgrimage and get married.', 'Umm, I guess so ...', "You're not really going to see the dead, more like your memories of them. People think of their relatives, and the pyreflies react to them. They take on the form of the dead person–an illusion, nothing else.", 'I keep my memories inside.', 'See you later!', "That's against the rules, isn't it?", "Wait up, I'll go with ya!", "Yunie's not getting married, is she?", "That's no thing to say! I think she should get married and stop being a summoner.", 'Yeah.', "Because it's tough, you know? In the end, she has to fight Sin.", "(Sighs) I guess you're right. Too bad.", "Ho-ho! That's the way to go! Then, you could take her away and live a quiet life somewhere. Yeah, sounds good to me!", 'Yeah.', "Because it's tough, you know? In the end, she has to fight Sin.", "(Sighs) I guess you're right. Too bad.", 'See ya! (Leaps off balcony and cat-lands on the level below, then waves.Maybe someday!', "Say, you ever think about gettin' married?", 'I think about it a lot.', 'Some people marry really young in Spira, you know.', "Yeah. Fiends are around, and there's always Sin, right? One of them might get you, you know? Lots of people marry the first person they fall in love with, just like that!", "I'll probably be the same way.", 'Rikku You an only child?', 'I got an older brother, myself.', 'I wish I had some younger brothers and sisters, though ...', 'Mom died ... A machina went on a rampage ...', "When I get married, I'm gonna have lots of kids! That way they'll all have brothers and sisters! What?", "When we leave here, we have to go through the Thunder Plains next, you know. I can't stand thunder!", "(Calling) Yuna, let's go!", "Maybe he wasn't expecting Yuna's answer so soon.", '(Cowers after another crack of lightning) I think I forgot something in Guadosalam.', "Okay, okay! I'll go!", 'Heh heh heh heh heh heh heh ...', 'Eh heh heh heh heh heh heh ...', "I wanna go home! I hate lightning! I hate thunder! Let's go rest over there! Please?", 'I know, but ... Just for a little while?', "Pretty please? Just for a few minutes? I'm scared of lightning! Let's rest, please? Pretty please? I'm too young to die! You're mean ... cruel! Your moms would be ashamed of you! Are you having fun doing this to me?", "I've been scared of lightning ever since.", 'My brother said that, too.', 'Another thunderclap Aaaaah!', 'Shhh!', "It's not stopping, is it?", "All right, already. But! You didn't have to say it like that, you know! You could be more comforting or something! You know, try to cheer me up? You just don't get me at all, do you? Hey! Are you listening? (Cringes at thunderclap, then shouts) I'm not scared! I'm not scared, you hear?", "We're almost out of here! Let's go!", "Yunie ... (Takes Y's shoulders, glares up at another flash) Quiet! (To Yuna) I wish we could help somehow, some way!", 'Slowpokes!', "I think there's more.", "Can we go now? I'm tired of waiting!", 'Oh, no!', 'Oh, no!', "He's gonna use an anti-magic field on us!", 'Yuna! You can use magic and call aeons now!', 'I am the guardian of Yuna, you see? Yuna is safe! We will guard her! She is safe!', '(nervous laugh) I told him I was a guardian. Well, guess I had to, really.', "Because I'm Al Bhed. And that ... was my brother.", "You're wrong! We have nothing against Yevon.", 'You got proof? Show me proof!', "That's not good enough! Yevon says this, Yevon says that. Can't you think for yourself?", "I ... I don't know!", "But ... that doesn't mean you should do whatever they say without thinking! Nothing will ever change that way!", 'You want Sin to keep coming back? There might be a way to stop it, you know!', 'When? How?', 'Why do I even bother?', 'Hm?', "I'm sorry.", 'You sure you know how to drive this?', "He didn't have to be so mean, yeah? I almost cried.", "Just kidding! It's okay. At least you're still nice.", 'Hey, do I look like Yunie, you think?', "Well, my dad's sister is Yunie's mother, you get it?", 'Mm-hm.', "Yuna's not the only one that I want to protect.", 'We Al Bhed want to protect all of the summoners, you know? Summoners are ... Well, you could say that ... they sacrifice themselves to, well ... to bring happiness to Spira.', 'Oh ...', 'Yes?', 'You know, the pilgrimage ... It, uh, takes a lot out of you.', "I hope you're right.", "I've decided to be Yuna's guardian now, and that's all I want.", 'Will Yuna be all right?', "Wait, wait! Jyscal's sphere! We can show it to them!", "I'm sure Yunie's okay. She's breathing fine and all. How are Lulu and Wakka?", "She's so together. All grown up, I guess.", 'Well, just give me five or six more years.', "(Bops Tidus) Hey, don't change the subject!", 'Kimahri, too!', 'Huh?', 'Oh! I will!', "Huh? Hey! Are you saying I'll never be like Rikku! Kimahri!", "Hey! You don't have to say it like that!", "You don't have to say it like that.", "I can't believe you said that!", 'Yeah! Kimahri roars, and Auron runs off, and ...', 'Yep!', 'Friends, huh?', 'Heh heh. Friends, huh? First time a non-Al Bhed called me that. Ee-hee-hee.', 'Hmm?', 'Oh! Hey, guys!', 'Hmm? (Stamps) Kimahri, too!', "Where's Yunie?", "Umm ... There's something I wanna tell you, but promise not to say anything.", "No glaring either! I know where we are. We're on Bikanel Island. There's a place us Al Bhed call Home near here. Yunie's there, I'm sure of it! Other Al Bhed must've come and rescued her!", "That's right! Anyway, I will take you there if you promise ... that you won't tell anyone about it. Especially not Yevonites, okay? You know they don't like us Al Bhed. Who knows what they'll do if they knew?", 'Yevon did something really bad to us before.', "Just promise you won't tell anyone about this island. Promise?", 'You got it!', 'Let me handle the machina! I can take them apart piece by piece!', 'That way!', 'Uhh.. Which way was it again?', 'Over here!', 'Umm ... This way!', "Umm ... I think I'm lost.", "Keyakku! Who? Who's attacking us?", 'Keyakku? Keyakku!', 'Father ...', "Cid. Leader of the Al Bhed ... He's my dad.", 'Yeah. We have to save Yunie.', 'Right!', 'This is terrible!', 'Oh, no!', 'We have to get underground!', "The Summoners' Sanctum! This way!", 'Over here!', 'No, not that way!', "You're right. You're right, Wakka. We Al Bhed, we ... we weren't always like this. Sin destroyed the island where we all used to live. After that, we were scattered to every corner of Spira. But then, my dad brought the Al Bhed together again. If we few put our minds to it and worked together, then we could make a new home. Everyone worked hard, we had our Home back again ... But now ... Why did things have to turn out this way?", "The Summoners' Sanctum is where we keep the summoners. We keep them safe there.", "(nods) I know it's against the teachings and all that ...", "The pilgrimages have to stop! If they don't, and they get to Zanarkand ... They might defeat Sin. Yunie could ... but then she ... Yunie will die, you know?", "You know, don't you? Summoners journey to get the Final Aeon. Yuna told you, didn't she? With the Final Aeon, she can beat Sin. But then ... but then ... If she calls it, the Final Aeon's going to kill her! Even if she defeats Sin, it will kill Yunie too, you know!", "But Wakka, that's just totally wrong! Summoners shouldn't have to sacrifice themselves ... just so the rest of Spira can be happy, right?", "We're ... we're going to blow up our Home.", 'You can cram your happy festival, you big meanie!', "I'm okay. I'm fine. Really.", "Remember this ship? It's the one we found under the sea!", "Can't Yunie end her pilgrimage?", "What's Seymour doing alive? Didn't we take care of him in Macalania?", 'Whoa, scary!', 'Wonder if that will work.', "Yeah! We're gonna save Yunie, and nobody's gonna stop us!", "(Imitating Dad's accent, sort of) But destroy the ship and all go down together!", 'Thanks.', 'What is that?', 'There he goes again.', "Not alone, you won't!", '!', '!', "She's not stopping, is she?", "But, I can't just let her go.", 'But how?', "But what if you can't?", 'But ...', 'Okay.', 'Okay!', 'Ugh ... This is a toughie.', 'Where are we?', "What's a fayth doing in a place like this?", "'Cause then the summoner won't die!", 'Mm-hm!', 'Yeah! Yeah!', "You think of anything yet? I ... there's just so little time. Uh ... I don't know. Ugh ... This is a toughie ...", 'Zanarkand is on the other side, you know?', 'Yunie is gonna get the Final Aeon, you know?', "I still haven't thought of anything.", 'What are we gonna do?', 'Hey ...', 'Just now you sounded like a leader, you know?', 'A-haa! (Mock-bows) Huh?', 'You are not fighting him alone!', 'This many?', "(To Auron) Hey, you know something, don't you? Spill the beans!", 'Yunie might die, you know?', 'Huh?', 'Wake up! Wake up!', 'Hey! We were so worried about you!', "Hey! Can't we rest a little?", "I know, that's why I want to stop for a bit. Soon means that ... there's not much time left.", "Fine. I'll think on the way.", "Yuna, I say no! If we go down there, then you'll ...", "I'm not saying we shouldn't go. But shouldn't we think about it some more? There's gotta be some kind of way we can save you, Yuna!", 'Yunie ...', "Don't say that, Yunie! It's not over yet!", 'No ... You can tell him yourself.', "Yunie, don't say that because ... we're gonna see each other again, okay?", 'What ... what was that?', 'Seymour?', 'You mean, there is no Final Aeon?', "Why didn't you tell us!?", "Someone's coming!", '"You\'ll think of something"?', "You really think she'll help you?", "Well, I'm fighting!", 'What?', '"Where, where?" That all you can say? Why don\'t you think of something!?', 'Hmm ... uuuuhh ... Still thinking.', "(Hand over Wakka's mouth) It was my idea. Let me tell them!", '(Shoves in front of him) I just thought!', "That's why he was listening to it in Macalania!", 'Yeah! It could really work!', 'It really was my idea, you know.', "If they want a fight, let's give 'em one!", 'What?', '(Credible imitation of Shelinda) Stand down!', 'What was that about evil Al Bhed?', 'Hey, hey, wait! What was all that about the Al Bhed lying and stuff?', 'Oh ... Okay.', "Wait, gramps! Who's Yu Yevon?", 'Hey! Maybe you could help us with the hymn.', "It's like, we need you to tell as many people as you can.", 'A ship in the sky will sing the Hymn of the Fayth. When they hear it, we need everyone to sing along!', "You don't have to! Just tell everyone!", "My pop says he's got a special surprise for Sin. Can't wait till this is over so we can relax for a change! Don't worry, we'll be fine! Everyone'll sing for us, I know it!", "Aww ... now I'm feeling all warm inside.", "Pops! I'm countin' on you!", 'Oh, right on!', 'Figures.', 'I can hear the song!', 'They listened to us!', 'Huh? Hmm? ... . WHOA!', "Sin's pulling us in!", 'Go near more! or Father! Go far!', 'Easy for you to say!', "The main gun's busted!", 'See you there!', "Yeah! We're winning!", "Pop's machina always seem to break down when you need them most.", "(Interrupting over the intercom) Yunie! Guys! Come look! Something's happening to Sin!", "Don't worry. I'll cover you!", 'Sometimes, when I got a lot on my mind, it just helps to go "Aaaaa!" Once the Calm starts, we\'ll take the airship to your Zanarkand! Just a feeling, but I think my dad kinda likes you.', 'Not now!', "We're gonna see you again ... ?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Byntuh sa.', 'Ah, forgive me, sir. I meant to say "pardon me," but it came out in Al Bhed.', 'Mm-hm. I am Rin, owner of this establishment. Hela du saad oui.', 'If you are interested ... Al Bhed primers can be found all over Spira. Finding them and learning our language might be fun. Here, let me give you one in commemoration of our meeting. Although you might want to be careful where you speak our language.', 'It is a shame.', 'Oh! Thank you for your help. Please, use this.', 'It is a ferocious beast! Be prepared!', 'Have you an interest in renting some chocobos? As a token of our gratitude, the first time is free of charge. Please ask the attendant, if you wish to rent.', 'We appreciate this thing you have done. Dryhg oui. It means, "I thank you." There are branches of my travel agency all over Spira. Your patronage is always welcome.', '(Emerging from back) Nice to see you again. Welcome to the Rin Travel Agency. (Notices Rikku) Oh?', 'Hmm.', 'How goes your study of our language?', 'That is good to hear. Allow me to present you with this book for your study.', 'I see. Well, it may not be essential for daily life.', 'I wonder ... Would that be Sir Auron, by any chance?', "Ah, as I thought! I've been wondering since I saw him at the Mi'ihen Highroad branch. (Approaches him) Sir Auron! I wonder if you remember me? Ten years ago, at the beginning of Lord Braska's Calm?", 'Not at all. I could not leave a wounded man to die. However, I was surprised when I saw you gone the next morning, with that wound. An ordinary man would not have been able to walk.', 'Oh ... He looks so much like him.', 'Maester Seymour and his entourage passed by a while ago. And the maester is to be married soon?', 'The Guado are telling everyone.', "Welcome to Rin's.", 'Well, well. It appears you, too, have escaped harm.', 'I came to Home to pick up some goods and found myself here. Quite the escape. Thankfully, my goods were spared. Please let me know if you need any of my wares.', 'Thank you. Your patronage is very much appreciated. All proceeds will go to help restore Home.', 'Ah, how is your progress with our language?', "Just repeating what I've said is not talking, now. But your pronunciation's quite passable. You've been studying, I see.", 'May I help you?', "We're being attacked from within. Some of the Guado that attacked Home must have snuck on board.", 'I am calm about most things.', "Rikku, you've made some very good friends, I think. Good luck.", 'Evrae is truly mighty. Be well prepared.', 'I have faith in your victory.', "May I help you? Welcome! Rin's Aerial Branch office at your service. Welcome! How may I assist you today?", 'Thank you. Your patronage is very much appreciated.', 'Lady Yuna has become quite the summoner. A gentle nature, yet strong as steel. She reminds me of her parents.', 'Lord Braska wanted peace between his people and ours. He would occasionally visit the Home of those days.', 'They ran off together, into the night.', "Yes. He wouldn't talk to her after that. But, when Yuna was born, they made up again. His sister took off for Home at once. But then, her ship ...", "That incident turned Lord Braska down the summoner's path.", "But, you'll put an end to it?", 'I pray for your success.', 'Any last minute supplies before the showdown?', "But of course. Once Sin is gone, we'll need to be rebuilding Home, you see.", "If there's anything I can help you with in the future, just ask.", 'Very good! You have well learned our tongue.', 'To think the day would come, that we could talk so; it is joyous indeed!', 'Here, a present to congratulate your success!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
