Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I am Seymour Guado. I am honored to receive the title of Maester. In life, my father Jyscal worked to foster friendship between man and Guado. I vow to carry on his legacy, and to fulfill my duties as maester to the best of my abilities.', 'So we meet again, Lady Yuna.', 'You look troubled. Is there anything I can do?', 'I see.', 'Hold. I have a request.', 'I need to have Summoner Yuna and her guardians let through to the command center.', 'Do not worry. I will take full responsibility.', '(Turns to Yuna) It is done.', 'Brave Crusaders of Spira, protectors of all Spira. Believe in the path you have chosen, let faith be your strength! I, Seymour Guado, maester of Yevon, will bear witness to your deeds today.', "Ah, Sir Auron. It is an honor. I would be most interested in hearing what you've been doing these past ten years.", 'I ... see. Sir Auron must be a great asset as a guardian.', "Please, there's no need for formalities.", 'Please, speak as you normally would.', "It's true ... I should.", "However ... Both the Crusaders and the Al Bhed truly wish peace for Spira. This Operation Mi'ihen was born from that wish they share. Although it may be sacrilege to Yevon, their intentions are pure. And I, Seymour Guado– the person, not the maester of Yevon ... As a denizen of Spira, I wish them well in their endeavor.", "Pretend you didn't see them.", "Then, pretend I didn't say it.", '(Standing behind them) Lord Kinoc ...', 'Stand back, Lady Yuna.', "You won't hurt it. Your powers are still ... too weak.", "You can't!", "You do not look so well. But now more than ever, you must be the people's strength, their confidence.", 'Anyone else would be expected to show their sorrow.', "But you ... are a summoner. You are Spira's hope. Until Sin is defeated, you must not relent. Do you understand?", 'Are you afraid?', 'Yuna, take me as your pillar of strength. As Yunalesca had her lord Zaon.', 'Lady Yuna. Until next we meet, farewell.', '(Entering) That is enough, Tromell. Must I always endure such praise? (Yevon bow) Welcome!', "Please, make yourselves at home. There's no rush.", 'Pardon me. It has been a long time since I had guests. Lady Yuna, this way.', 'This sphere is a reconstruction created from the thoughts of the dead that wander the Farplane.', 'Correct. Zanarkand ... as it looked one thousand years ago. The great and wondrous machina city, Zanarkand.', '(Mysteriously) She once lived in this metropolis.', 'She was the first person to defeat Sin and save the world from its ravages. And you have inherited her name.', 'Of course. Lady Yuna–no, all summoners–are charged with bringing peace to Spira. But this means more than just defeating Sin. She must ease the suffering of all Spira. She must be a leader for the people. I proposed to Lady Yuna as a Maester of Yevon.', 'Even so, the actors must play their parts.', "(Approaches Yuna) There's no need to answer right away. Please, think it over.", 'Lady Yuna, I await your favorable reply.', 'Why are you still here, sir?', 'I beg your pardon. (Courtly bow) We Guado are keen to the scent of the Farplane.', 'Please be silent. Lady Yuna prays to the fayth.', 'What of it? Lady Yuna, certainly you know of these things, did you not?', 'Well then, why have you come here?', 'I see. You came to punish me, then.', 'What a pity.', 'Ah, of course. "Protect the summoner even at the cost of one\'s life." The Code of the Guardian. How admirable. Well, if you\'re offering your lives, I will have to take them.', 'So be it.', 'Your eyes, they burn with resolve ... Beautiful.', '... ... ...', 'Feel my pain! Come, Anima!', 'That power that defeated Anima ... It will be mine!', 'Ah, the son of Jecht.', 'Now is your time to die. Prepare yourself, son of Jecht.', 'Lady Yuna, it is a pleasure.', 'You could end the suffering of this poor Ronso.', 'Allow Kimahri to die, and release him from his pain. Spira ... is a land of suffering and sorrow caught in a spiral of death. To destroy–to heal–Spira, I will become Sin. Yes, with your help. Come with me, Yuna.', 'Once I have become the next Sin, your father will be freed again.', 'Pitiful mortal. Your hope ends here. And you meaningless existence with it.', "Do you not want to heal Spira's sorrow? Let death carry you off into peaceful slumber.", '(Banishing aeon) Death awaits you!', "No! Mother, no! I don't want you to become a fayth!", "I don't care about them! I need you, Mother! No one else!", '(Whispering) Sin has chosen me. I am part of Sin. I am one with Sin, forever. Immortal!', 'I will learn to control it, from within. I have all the time in the world. Since you were gracious enough to dispose of Yunalesca ... the only means of destroying Sin is forever gone. Now nothing can stop us!', "By all means, try! You should thank me.Your death means your father's life!", 'But there is no salvation for the damned!', 'Rest in peace, in eternal darkness!', 'Let darkness take you!', 'You would oppose me as well? So be it!', '(Stumbles backwards, falls to his knees ... ) No!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['There is no other way. Use me and defeat Sin. Only then will the people accept you.', "I don't ... have much time left.", 'So you know, yet still you seek my aid. My son ... do you not hate him?', 'It is all right. He is the one who sowed the seeds of hatred. He is to blame.', 'But I am at fault for letting him become what he was.', 'He was always alone–half Guado, half man. I wanted to give him the strength to live by himself. And so I became a fayth. But ... because I let him taste power, he began to thirst for more. He was not satisfied with my aeon. He wanted more. More power.', "Yes. Come, summoner. I will bestow you with my power The Dark Aeon, Anima. Destroy Sin, and my son's obsession with it. Though it is small recompense for what I did to him.", 'So you know, yet still you seek my aid? My son ... Do you not hate him?', 'It is all right. He is the one who sowed the seeds of hatred. He is to blame.', 'But I am at fault for letting him become what he was.', 'He was always alone–half Guado, half man. I wanted to give him the strength to live by himself. And so I became a fayth. But ... because I let him taste power, he began to thirst for more. He was not satisfied with my aeon. He wanted more. More power.', "Yes. Come, summoner. I will bestow you with my power The Dark Aeon, Anima. Destroy Sin, and my son's obsession with it. Though it is small recompense for what I did to him."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I am reporting to you live, from outside Luca Stadium. The excitement here has reached a feverish pitch as the opening ceremony gets under way ... H-Hey! I'm in the middle of a broadcast! Leave me alone!", "Hm? You want me to interview you? It's not like the Aurochs are going to make it past the first round anyway. Why bother with an interview when we already know the outcome?", "Well ... if you win at least one game, I'll grant you an interview.", "Do you know anything about the fiends inside the stadium? We have so few facts, we can't write up a feature on it yet.", "I've been interviewing eyewitnesses, but nobody seems to know a thing.", 'Oh yes, congratulations! I have a lot more respect for the Aurochs now.', "As you all know, Operation Mi'ihen ended in utter failure. With the Crusaders annihilated, the warrior monks and the Guado have been assigned to take up security posts in various locales. This dispatch was ordered by Maester Kinoc and Maester Seymour as they ... H-Hey! Would you stop interrupting my broadcast? You get enough attention already!", 'The mysterious disappearance of the summoners may somehow be connected to the Al Bhe ... Ahh! Just let me do my job!', "Even as faith in the Yevon clergy dwindles, the temple remains silent, choosing not to issue any official statement on the matter. Many are protesting the cold and insensitive manner in which the temple has treated the people. There have even been reports of a mass exodus from Bevelle by dejected temple followers ... Wh-What do you think you're doing!? Can't you see I'm working here? You sure are a show-off, aren't you! We have unconfirmed reports that Maester Seymour has committed an unspeakable crime ... Will you move!?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["But Yevon's teachings say ...", 'I-I only meant to ...', 'Lady Summoner ... ?', 'It is an honor, my lady. My name is Shelinda. I am a disciple of Yevon.', 'I heard they were to use forbidden machina! I had to stop them.', "But, it's not about defeating Sin! The teachings of Yevon must be upheld!", "But you don't understand! The Crusaders won't even listen to me. And it's all because I'm just a lowly acolyte.", "Yes! Yes, you're right, my lady. Absolutely right!", 'Thank you so much, Lady Yuna! Now I feel I have the courage to finish my training.', 'I will do my best to get myself appointed to a temple, as a nun.', "I've heard that the proprietor, Mr. Rin, is an Al Bhed. But I was very relieved to find that he keeps nothing sacrilegious here.", 'Thank you so much for your words yesterday.', 'Word has gotten around about me. Now all the Crusaders are ignoring me!', "In the end, I wasn't able to stop them, as you can see. But seeing their fierce determination, I couldn't just sit there. So I decided that I would do everything in my power to help them.", "Truly, I know nothing of the ways of fighting, but I do know some white magic. I'm hoping that will be of some use to them.", 'Is there anything I can do to help you?', 'Take care!', 'Are you all right?', 'Thank you, I will.', 'Good day, everyone. We can all learn a lesson from what has happened to the Crusaders. Only the truly faithful have a hope of defeating Sin.', "I'm thinking of going to Guadosalam. I have not spoken with the Guado for some time.", "Oh, how fare you, Sir Guardian? It seems that Maester Seymour has returned to Guadosalam. He's young, but he deserves our respect. The maester is also the high priest of Macalania temple. So he administers both the temple and Guado affairs. I hope to get an audience with Maester Seymour, myself.", 'My ... Was the lady summoner not with you?', "That's all right.", 'Oh! Maester Seymour left Guadosalam a short while ago.', 'I believe he went to the temple in Macalania. Maester Seymour is also the high priest of that temple.', 'Please, tell the lady Yuna that I am doing just as she advised me! I, too, will go to the temple in Macalania shortly.', "Is it true? I heard that Maester Seymour and Lady Yuna are to be wed! It's such great news! I have to tell everyone!", 'From the Guado. They were all very excited!', 'Oh ... Really?', "I see ... That's unfortunate. Well I'm sure that people would have rejoiced all over Spira. (Sigh) Please give Lady Yuna my best regards! Oh, please go ahead.", 'Hey! It will not do to joke about a thing like that. Maester Seymour and Lady Yuna–how wonderful! Oh, please go ahead.', 'Ah! There you are!', "So Lady Yuna is getting married. You shouldn't kid around about these things.", "Maester Seymour and Lady Yuna ... I couldn't be happier ... even if it was my own wedding. Now, victims of Sin will have something to be joyful about.", "You're not happy?", "I believe ... she's gone to the Cloister of Trials with Maester Seymour.", "I am travelling north to tell the people the wonderful news! I am indebted to Lady Yuna. Wherever they are to hold the ceremonies, I'll make sure to be there. Please send my best regards to Lady Yuna.", 'What has happened? Is there anything I can do?', "Lady Yuna is not to be harmed! She's no traitor! That is an evil rumor spread by the Al Bhed!", 'Maester Mika himself told me.', 'As she says!', 'I ... Truly, I do not understand it myself. All Yevon seems to be in a state of confusion. Why, yesterday they called me out of the blue and made me captain of the guard!', "Yes, the chaos in the temples is worse than I'd imagined. It's horrible! And all the priests do is blame each other. I worry what will become of Yevon. But no! I must be the rock that stands against the swirling tides, right? Lady Yuna, I must tell you, your courage has been a great inspiration to me.", '(Entering) Where ... where is the grand maester?', "(Running in) I'm afraid the grand maester is nowhere to be found!", 'Oh ... I see.', 'What should I tell them?', "I'm not sure I understand.", 'A ship in the sky will sing the Hymn of the Fayth? So when they hear it, everyone should sing along, correct?', 'Truly?', "That's wonderful! You can count on me! I shall tell all of Spira!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Hey, you're an Aurochs player, aren't you? You were great today!", '(if Aurochs won) You ended a twenty-three-year losing streak. I never thought it would happen. What a miracle!', "(if Aurochs lost) Even though you didn't win, it was a good game. Keep up the good work.", "It may take awhile for the Crusaders to recover. I wonder what they're going to do now.", "The wedding of Maester Seymour and Lady Yuna will be extravagant. I'm sure it will go down in history.", "Is Lady Yuna a traitor or not? With everyone gabbing, I don't know what to believe."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["This gorge is called the Scar. They say that when the high summoner cornered Sin, Sin tore the earth here asunder with the last of its strength. The high summoner and Sin struck each other down at the gorge's bottom. Lord Gandof's sacrifice brought us the Calm. In the Calm Lands, we bury our dead in this gorge. We cannot send them because few summoners ever make it this far. I've heard that the dead that don't receive a proper sending roam the bottom of the gorge as fiends.", 'So many people ... Much more than in the Calm Lands.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I don't know if it's the toxin, but I can't remember a thing. Like my name, my house ... I thought someone might notice me and help me out if I sat here. But no one's paying any attention. I guess everyone has their own problems to worry about.", 'Hey, I may not even be from around here. Maybe I come from someplace far away ... Who knows?', "The toxin's effect wore off. I remember my family now ... Sin attacked, and my family, they ... They all went to the Farplane. Heh, it was better to have forgotten everything.", 'The next time Sin comes around, I want to go to the Farplane, too.', "The warrior monks aren't here anymore. They returned to Bevelle. The warrior monks probably don't consider Kilika worth protecting."]

Title: Final Fantasy X

We've got a job to do, don't we?", "You know ... for the first time, I'm glad ... to have you as my father.", 'You stay away!', 'Yuna!', 'Everyone! This is the last time we fight together, okay?', "What I'm trying to say is ... after we beat Yu Yevon, I'll disappear!", "I'm saying goodbye!", "I know it's selfish ... but this is my story!", "Yuna, I have to go. I'm sorry I couldn't show you Zanarkand. (Starts walking away) Goodbye!", 'What is this place?', "So he's here?", 'Not a chance!', '(Yelling and punching the air) Come on out, Omega!', 'I almost got eaten by a fiend here. Payback time!', 'And he found Sin.', 'And this is your home? What? You got something against company?', "You're dead, too?", "I'll do my best.", 'Perhaps later.', 'I am in your debt!', 'Easy, once you know the trick!', 'I am happy too!', 'Thank you!', 'Sorry, no time for that.', 'Sorry, no time for that.', "All right, I'll do it!", 'Would you explain that again?', "All right, I'll do it!", "Let's see your weapons.", "I'd like some items.", 'Show me the fiends captured so far.', "That's all.", 'Would you explain that again?', "Let's see your weapons.", "I'd like some items.", 'Show me the fiends captured so far.', "That's all.", 'Chat.', 'Fight monsters.', 'Buy weapons.', 'Buy items.', 'Exit.', 'Ride!', "Don't ride.", 'How do I race?', "If you don't have Celestial Mirror ...", 'If you have Celestial Mirror ...', "Walking's not that bad.", 'I want to ride a chocobo!', 'Let me ride one!', "I'll walk.", 'Let me train one.', 'How do you ride a chocobo?', 'Never mind.', 'How do you ride a chocobo?', 'Let me train one.', 'Never mind.', 'Once more? One more time!', 'I quit.', "Let's do something else.", 'Once more? One more time!', 'I quit.', "Let's do something else.", 'Something up there?', 'Whatcha up to?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Perhaps you could go look for us.', 'But he might die!', 'Do you ... Do you hate him so?', "If he dies, you'll never be able to tell him how much you hate him.", 'What? Really?', 'Just a sec, dear.', 'Just a sec, dear.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['We have been expecting you, Lady Yuna. Welcome to Guadosalam. This way, my lady. This way.', "Oh, I beg your pardon. I'm called Tromell Guado. I am in the direct servidce of our leader, the great Seymour Guado. Lord Seymour has very important business with Lady Yuna.", 'Please, come inside the manor. All will be explained. Of course, your friends are also welcome.', 'This way, please.', '(snootily) This way, please!', 'I will go inform Lord Seymour. Please wait here.', '(Re-enters) Truly, it is good to have guests again. Since Lord Jyscal passed away, these halls have been too quiet.', 'Truly, a loss for us all. But now a new leader, Lord Seymour, has come before us. Lord Seymour is the child of a Guado and a human. He will be the tie that binds our two races together. But that is not all, I think. Lord Seymour ... (spreads arms) He will surely become the shining star that lights the way for all the peoples of Spira.', 'My lady?', "But of course, my lady. Lord Seymour wishes nothing else, I'm sure.", 'Thank you!', 'Lady Yuna!', 'My lady!', "Ah, Lady Yuna's guardians! I haven't thanked you for your help earlier. (Japanese bow) Thanks to you I was able to bring Lady Yuna here safely. You have my sincerest gratitude. It ... isn't much, but I want you to have this. Lord Seymour and Lady Yuna's marriage will help foster goodwill between us and humankind. Lord Jyscal, rest his soul, would be pleased, I'm sure of it. Well ... we have much to do before the ceremony. We are all going to be very busy.", '(Entering with attendants) Lord Seymour! What happened here?', 'You did this?', 'No, stop! Stay away from him, traitors!', "No need, I already know what I'll tell the other maesters.", 'Lord Seymour was the leader of the Guado before becoming a maester.', 'Let you go? Lord Seymour would never forgive us if we did.', 'The Guado take care of Guado affairs.', 'Why are you in Guadosalam? What business have you here?', 'If it would please you to harm a defenseless old man ... then burn me, boil me, it matters not.', 'Lord Seymour is gone. No lord rises to take his place. The Guado merely wait for Sin to come and finish us off. Why should I care what you do to me? If it meant rejoining Lord Jyscal and Lord Seymour ... then your taking off my head would be the greatest kindness.', 'Come to kill the old man? I welcome it! Or are you here to laugh? Laugh at the fallen Guado?', 'I have prayed and prayed, yet Lord Seymour does not appear. Has he not reached the Farplane? Has he become a fiend? Oh, my poor Lord Seymour ... Tell me, where do you wander?', 'When Lord Jyscal was alive, the Guado knew prosperity and honor. But now, we Guado wither and crumble. I, myself, could have done more to stop this. Forgive me, Lord Jyscal! (Deep bow) Lord Jyscal! I beg your forgiveness!', "Benevolent Lord Jyscal, and most wise Lord Seymour. The days spent in your service were the best in this old man's life. Those of us left behind will soon be destroyed by Sin and join you in the Farplane. I will serve you there as I have served you in this world, always. Even should Sin disappear, the Guado are doomed without a leader."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Odd clothes you got. What land you from? This your first time to Besaid?', "We don't get many strangers here. I remember every visitor we get.", "Everyone's gone to the temple, but I'm more comfortable praying at home.", "And what if something happened? I'd be afraid to go see.", 'At last, Lady Yuna has become a true summoner like her father! She was so small when she first came to Besaid.', "I'm sure Lady Yuna will become a high summoner. Everyone in Besaid thinks so.", "I heard the Crusaders' operation failed. Maybe Luzzu and Gatta will repent and come home.", "I've no desire to go against the teachings, but something's not right with the temple these days.", "I've no desire to go against the teachings, but something's not right with the temple these days."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I can't figure out whether I'm gonna join the Aurochs or the Crusaders!", "I'm pretty good at blitz, ya? I can hold my breath and everything!", "Daddy doesn't play with me at all.", 'They say I gotta train in order to join the Crusaders ...', 'Me and Sir Luzzu and Gatta will beat Sin, just the three of us!', "Dad, come on! Let's go help!", 'Yeah, but ...', 'Yeah!', "Let's go help the summoner! I promise I'll be a good boy!", "Lady Yuna! Don't forget me, okay?", "I'll be good while you're gone! I promise, ya? Here, take this. Daddy says it's an offering.", 'I have to keep watch! Sin could come any day!', 'A summoner came to this village not long ago. Now what was his name?', 'Looks like you got over the toxin, ya?', "Sir Luzzu and the others aren't back. What could have happened?", 'When are the Aurochs gonna come back?', 'Some mean-looking people were here, looking for Yuna!', "We got letters from the Aurochs! They're doing great in Luca, ya?", "Is it true Lady Yuna's a traitor? No one here believes that at all!", "I wonder if all this singing's really gonna help beat Sin.", "We got letters from the Aurochs! They're doing great in Luca, ya?", 'I wonder if Sin is really going to go away?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["If the Kilika Beasts win, it'll give the whole island something to celebrate. Thinking about that makes me want to practice harder.", "Hey, the Aurochs' locker room is on the other side. Or are you just here to scout?", 'Well, we lost in the tournament ... but no point dwelling on the past! Better to practice harder than to mope around!', "Next time, I'll show 'em the Kilika spirit we've inherited from Lord Ohalland.", "Even if Sin comes back, I ain't budging from this spot. I'm going to use Sin's tidal wave for a crash training course! Just you watch, Lord Ohalland! I've got enough fighting spirit left in me to put you to shame!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Hey! You okay?', 'Whoa-ho!', 'You wanna try that move one more time?', "You're no amateur. Who you play for?", 'What team you say again?', "Sin's toxin got to you. But, you're still alive. Praise be to Yevon!", 'All right, back to practice!', "I'm Wakka, coach and captain of the Besaid Aurochs, brudda.", "What? You hungry? Okay! Back to the village. I'll get you somethin'!", "Long time ago, there were a whole lot of cities in Spira. Big cities with machina–machines–to run 'em. People played all day and let the machina do the work. And then, well, take a look.", "Sin came, and destroyed the machina cities. And Zanarkand along with 'em. Yeah, that was about a thousand years ago, just like you said. If you ask me, Sin's our punishment for letting things get out of hand. What gets me, though ... is we gotta suffer, 'cause of what some goofballs did way back when! 'Course, we must always repent for our sins! That's important! It's just that, it's hard to keep at it sometimes, you know?", "(Guffaws) But you from the Zanarkand Abes–that was a good one! Hey, I'm not saying the team never existed, ya? But you gotta figure a team livin' in luxury like that'd be pretty soft, eh?", "Hey! It's this way!", 'Got a favor to ask ya.', "(Lets go) A major blitz tournament's coming up. All the teams in Spira'll be there! It's so huge, I'm sure someone there will recognize you! Then you can go back to your old team, right? It'll be fun! What do you say, huh? Come on, come on!", 'Dude! Our team is gonna rock, eh?', "This is where I was born. I started blitz when I was five. I joined the Aurochs at thirteen ... ten years ago.Ten years ... and we never won a game. Well, after last year's tournament, I quit. Time seemed right.", 'So, after quitting, I got this new job, ya? But every time my mind wandered, I thought about the game.', "(Grunts) My first match last year was my big chance. But something else was on my mind. I couldn't focus.", 'Hey, hey!', "I don't care how we do. Long as we play our best. If we give it our all, I can walk away happy.", 'Victory? You serious?', "it's an ancient custom. People leaving the island pray here for a safe trip. They say it works pretty good.", 'Luzzu and Gatta–Crusaders.', 'What, you forgot that too?', "Hey, sorry. Don't worry about it. I'll help you out.", "Cool! About the Crusaders, you can ask them yourself. They've got a lodge in the village.", 'Besaid Village.', "We'll get you something over there later. Take a look around first. Let's see ... The Crusaders Lodge is over yonder. Luzzu and Gatta are usually there.", 'Hm.', 'Oh, right.', 'Over here!', 'You do remember the prayer, right?', "Man, that's like the basics of the basics. Alright. I'll show you.", "You ... must have forgot or something. Here, I'll show you.", '(Yevon bow in slow-motion) Go ahead, you try.', 'Go present yourself to the temple summoner before we eat, ya? A little praying might do your memory some good!', 'Sorry, man. No time for lunch yet. Take a nap! You look bushed.', "We can't interfere. It's a rule.", "The summoner hasn't returned from the trial.", 'Well, apprentice summoner, really ...', "There's a room in there called the Cloister of Trials. Beyond is where the apprentice summoner prays. If the prayer is heard, the apprentice becomes a fully-fledged summoner, remember?", "A day's already gone by.", 'Sometimes, yes.', "There's already guardians in there. Besides, it's forbidden.", "Hey! What's gotten into you?", "Hey, it's okay.", "Only summoners, apprentice summoners, and their guardians can enter here. It's a tradition. Very important.", "Me? I'm a guardian.", "Summoners go on a pilgrimage to pray at every temple in Spira. Guardians protect them. The guardians in there now ... One of them's got a short fuse, and who knows what the other's thinking.", "Well, now that we've come this far ... might as well go all the way!", "No, it's uh ... it's just ...", '(Nudges Tidus) See, I told you she gets mad easily.', 'Hey, over here!', 'Wait till you see this!', '(Lets go, waves to Yuna) Ready!', 'Let me introduce you to the team.', "This guy here wants into the tournament so bad, I let him on the team. His memory's a little fuzzy, so don't mind him if he says anything odd! Come on, say hi.", "Nope, we got a new goal now! Our new goal ... is victory! To win every match, defeat every opposing team! To bring the Crystal Cup back to our island! That's all we need to do to win! Easy, ya?", 'We sure got the boys worked up, huh?', "(Nudges T. after she's gone) She's cute, ya?", "Don't get no ideas.", "Then we're cool.", "That's not going to happen. If you get tired, let me know. I had a bed made for you.", 'Hm? Ready for bed?', "Don't overdo it. We leave early tomorrow.", 'Good. Sleep tight.', 'Yeah, but ... he needed our help!', 'Yeah, but ...', 'My little brother, Chappu. He looked like you.', "He was with the Crusaders when they fought Sin last year. He didn't make it. I first heard on the day of the tournament.", 'I became a guardian to fight Sin, ya?', "That was the idea. But ... I'm more worried about a stupid game now than avenging my brother. Well, after the next tournament, I'll be a guardian full-time.", "I know it kinda looks like I'm using you, but I'm not.", "(starts to shake hands then waves T. away) Heh. Stop, you're embarrassing me!", 'Yeah, use it well!', 'Well, he never used it.', "Where's Yuna?", 'Yuna came to this village ten years ago, when the last Calm started.', "Since then, she's been like a little sister to me and Lulu. But she had the talent ... She became an apprentice. Now, today, she leaves as a summoner.", "This isn't a vacation, Yuna.", 'Okay! Off we go!', "Here comes one now ... Hey, why don't ya try out that sword I gave you?", 'Not too shabby! You kept up with him pretty well. Might make a good guardian someday.', 'That ... looks like trouble.', "Told you. Only magic can beat that thing. If you can't beat 'em down, you gotta use magic of an element they don't like.", "Let's have our black mage show you what I mean. Lu! You're up!", 'Whoa! Hey! What are you healing that thing for?', "Enough with the lesson, Lu. Let's get this over with, ya?", "(Folds arms) We're gonna wait.", 'Are you ready?', "It's an ancient custom. People leaving the island pray here for a safe trip.", "Chappu didn't pray that day. Said he'd miss his boat.", "That's enough!", "He's another of Yuna's guardians.", "True, true. But, uh ... Why don't we let our summoner show us what she's made of!", "Your first real battle! Let's see some style!", 'Another one of those? No problem. Leave this one to me, ya? Say goodnight, birdie!', "Come to think of it, I haven't told you where we're going! First to Kilika Island, then we change boats and head for Luca. 'Fore that, though, Yuna's gotta pray at the temple. I'll be guarding. We'll be praying for the Aurochs' victory, too, so you come along, ya?", 'Hey, it is a great plan!', "She's the daughter of High Summoner Braska! You saw his statue at the temple. Lord Braska defeated Sin ten years ago. Yuna's the heir to a great legacy!", 'Eh?', 'Huh?', 'Oh yeah, you talk to Yuna yet? She had some questions for you.', "What do you think you're doing? Stick a harpoon in it and we'll all get dragged under!", 'Wait! Oh, boy ...', 'This place is crawling!', 'The fin! Attack the fin!', 'Ah, there you are!', 'Besaid Aurochs! Huddle!', 'On to the temple, where we pray for victory!', 'High Summoner Ohalland used to live in the Kilika temple here. Yep, Lord Ohalland was once a great blitzer, you know?', 'Hm?', 'Something wrong with enjoying blitzball?', "This is the only time! The players fight with all their strength; the fans cheer for their favorite team. They forget pain, suffering ... Only the game matters! That's why blitz has been around for so long. Least that's what I think.", "Let's play ... and win! Right?", "(Turns and points) Temple's beyond the jungle there. Let's go!", "What's up?", 'Yuna! What? This is no times for jokes, ya?', "He may be a blitzball whiz kid, but up against fiends, he's a newbie.", 'O-ho! These stone steps have a history, you know? Yep, Lord Ohalland trained here at his peak.', 'Mm.', 'Yuna, if you would.', 'Hey! Hey!', 'Everyone, quick! Sinspawn!', "My ball can't hurt it either! How 'bout magic!?", 'Sorry about that! Hoped to break you in a little slower.', 'You handled yourself pretty well. You got talent.', "Leave 'em alone, and Sin comes back for 'em. You gotta be quick!", 'So, uh ... they got fiends in Zanarkand, too?', "I been thinking. Maybe people Sin gets to don't die. Maybe Sin carries 'em through time. Like a thousand years through time. And then one day, maybe they just pop back, see?", 'Hm?', 'Well, stuff happens. Best not to worry.', 'You here to pray for victory, too?', 'Oh, yeah? Then why are you here?', 'See you in the finals!', 'Lord Ohalland, guide our feet.', "The fayth is below. Let's do it!", 'She could be excommunicated!', 'Just wait.', 'The fayth, remember?', 'She prays with all her heart for a way to defeat Sin.', "It's taboo!", 'Just wait.', 'Off to Luca at last! The matches start soon as we get there, so rest up on the way, ya?', "Relax! He's bound to know someone in Luca.", "He could always join a blitz team. Anyhow, it's better than just leaving him in Besaid!", 'What do you want me to do?', "Oh, yeah, geez ... There's that too, eh?", 'Not mine!', '(slumps) It is mine, huh?', 'Why do you think she wants to make him a guardian, anyway?', 'Oh, right.', "Wait, you sure 'bout that? He's really Sir Jecht's son?", 'Okay.', "Well, yeah, I mean ... He's gotta decide for himself, ya? Well, him and Yuna, I guess.", 'Ahem!', 'Should what?', 'Why me?', 'Why not?', "Aren't you being over-sensitive?", "All right, all right. I'll try talking to him after the tournament.", "I know. It's his decision.", "He doesn't like his father?", "Hating your own father, huh? Sounds like a luxury to me. I don't even remember my parents. Can't say how I feel about 'em.", 'Sin just takes everything away from us.', "Go to bed, bud. Tournament starts tomorrow morning. [As Tidus starts downstairs ... ] Someone's bound to recognize you when they see your moves out there.", "Whoah! What's that called?", 'Show us one more time, ya?', "I knew it! I knew you were somethin' special!", "Hey! It's past your bedtime, kiddos!", 'Show me that move again!', "It's like this every year, ya? Don't let it bother you.", "What in Yevon's name were you doing up there?", 'Hey! Mind your mouth, now.', 'Shhhh!', '(Nudges Tidus) You, too! Bow your head!', 'Really psyches you up, ya? All right! Last meeting before the match! Hustle!', 'Heh-heh!', "We're playin' the Al Bhed Psyches first. If we win, we're in the finals!", "That's right, we got seeded! Two wins and we're the champions!", "First things first. Let's go over the basics again, boys.", 'Hey! Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey! The game starts like real soon! C-Come back quick, ya?', 'Yeah, okay.', "I'm ... I'm counting on you, bud!", 'How can you let some Al Bhed kidnap you?', "Don't go near Al Bhed any more, okay? They're trouble.", 'The game starts soon. No time for warm-ups. Ready?', "All right! (stands) I got something to tell you boys. After this game ... I'm retiring. I promised myself this would be my last tournament. Win or lose, I'm quitting blitzball. But you know ... Since we're here, we might as well win!", "I'm warming the bench. He's taking my place.", "All right, boys, let's win this one! Let's make the Goers goners!", "Hey, you weren't supposed to see that.", 'Zone defense, boys! Stop those Goers!', 'Get the ball and just shoot like crazy!', 'All right! Hustle!', 'Sir Auron!', 'Yeah. Best guardian there ever was.', "Yuna needs me with her now. I can't be lying around in some bed.", "Come on, look sharp! The blitz season just started. Don't make those faces, ya? (Hands trophy or ball to Datto) Well ... See you, boys! You be good.", "I can't hear you!", "Never liked long goodbyes anyway. Sorry for making you wait, Yuna. I had some promises to keep, ya? From now on, I'm your full-time guardian.", "Heeey. (Holds up hand to stop her, then bows less deeply in return) It's good to be back, ya?", '(To Lulu) So, any news on what happened?', "Do you think he's gonna stay here?", "In any case, I'll miss having him around.", 'Whoa.', "You're serious?", 'O-Of course! No problem at all!', "Where'd you meet Sir Auron, anyway?", 'Ah, nevermind.', "Sin's toxin sure is taking its time wearing off.", "Anyway, I knew you'd find someone you knew here. We'll be taking the Mi'ihen Highroad north, towards Djose Temple.", "We were just worried you guys might've gone crazy!", "Told ya, Sir Auron's the best!", "What was all that about? The Crusaders' operation?", 'Mm.', 'Yeah! Right!', 'But, this is an Al Bhed shop!', "They don't believe in Yevon, and in Luca they ... They kidnapped Yuna!", "I'm not tired one bit!", 'Look out! Cliff behind us!', "Let's get him!", "He's a maester. Better get used to it, ya?", "What's goin' on? Why's Maester Seymour backing the Crusaders, eh? They're using the Al Bhed's machina! They're violating the teachings!", '(Sputters) Lulu?', 'Excuse me ... Maester Seymour? Why is your Lordship ... presently ... present here ... sir?', "Uuuh ... Isn't this operation against the teachings of Yevon? Aren't you gonna stop them?", 'Mm! Mm!', "But, using machina ... That's bad, isn't it?", "Beg your pardon, but that's not something a maester should say!", "You're kidding!", "At least there's no chance he'll get hurt. Why are you guys fighting, anyway? Aren't the almighty Al Bhed machina enough?", '(Turns and peers at both of them) What?', "When we used to play blitz together, Chappu used to say ... He'd say that–when we won the Cup, ya?–he'd propose to Lulu. And then one day ... he goes off and becomes a Crusader. Just like that.", 'Lu, you knew?', "Luzzu! Don't die out there.", 'Lots! Lots more!', 'Curse these ... ! (Kicks cannon) OW!', "That's got nothing to do with it! I just hate these sacrilegious contraptions!", "Grrr ... It won't work anyway.", "Hmph! All right, all right! But I still think machina are bad news. They're forbidden for a reason!", 'Um, you all right?', "With them here, it's like Yevon authorizes this whole operation!", "It blocked my shot, ya? I don't believe it!", 'That, I can hit, eh?', "You can't ignore the teachings.", 'Still a ways.', "That's a summoner's training. She's gotta prepare mind and body, all just to get ready for the Final Summoning.", "That means another summoner's already in there.", 'Where is he?', 'That ... idiot!', 'Luzzu! Knock it off!', 'I ... do ... know!', "Why don't you ... go home now, to Besaid. Take it easy a while. Rest, ya?", "You need some R & R. You're hurt, ya?", "Get better. I can't beat up on you when you're all depressed, eh?", 'All right! Guardians, at attention!', "All right ... Let's do it!", 'We wait here.', 'Calling the personal guardian to Lord Braska riffraff?', 'Quite the show, ya? Not so good on the heart, though. Not all summoners are like Yuna, I guess.', "We're leavin' once Yuna gets here.", 'Yo! Sleepyhead!', "A summoner with bed hair! What's the world comin' to?", "Let the Ronso deal with Ronso problems, ya? That's how it's always been.", 'Whoa!', "Hey, we better hurry or we'll miss the shoopuf!", 'This is a shoopuf.', "All right! We board soon as we're ready, ya?", "Let the driver know when you're ready.", 'How little you know! Some things little boys never grow out of!', '(and Tidus) Right?', 'Hey.', 'A machina city– a thousand years old! They built this city on top of bridges across the river.', "Right. It's a good lesson.", 'Yeah. Why build a city over a river, ya?', "Nope, that's not why. They just wanted to prove they could defy the laws of nature!", "Yevon has taught us When humans have power, they seek to use it. If you don't stop them, they go too far, ya?", "Remember Operation Mi'ihen? That kind.", 'They kept building more and more powerful machina.', 'But the war did not stop!', "So, Sin's our punishment for lettin' things get out of hand, eh?", 'Yeah, it is.', "It's because of people like the Al Bhed screwin' everything up!", 'The Al Bhed!', "Yuna, we'll save you!", 'Grrah! Those Al Bhed!', "Damn the Al Bhed! What do they want from us? Could it have something to do with Luca? What are they after Yuna for? Wait! They're mad they lost the tournament! Or, wait! They're mad about Operation Mi'ihen!", 'Ah! So the Al Bhed are behind that! Those sand-blasted grease monkeys!', 'Well ... I guess so.', 'Might be more Al Bhed! Keep watch, ya?', 'Yo! Friend of yours?', 'Wow, so you, like, owe her your life! What luck meeting here, ya? Praise be to Yevon!', 'So, uh ... Rikku ... You look a little beat up! You okay?', 'Huh? What?', 'Oh, go ahead.', 'Mmmph.', "I'm for it! The more, the merrier!", 'Wh-what did you just do!?', 'Whoa, whoa, whoa!', "I don't like the smell of this one, eh?", "Maester Seymour doesn't look like them, though.", "I get the feeling he called us up here for more than just dinner. Nothing 'gainst the maester, but I hope we get this over with quick.", 'He brought the teachings of Yevon to the Guado. He was truly a great man.', "Sounds just like a passin' daydream, like Auron says.", 'He sure picked a fine time to lay this one on us.', "You're thinking those funny thoughts again, ya?", "You'll see once we get there.", "Yo, Chappu! Meant to come see you earlier, ya? Sorry! (Japanese bow, stays down in apology) I know you won't hold it against me.", "I gave up the game. I'm a guardian from here on, you know?", 'This guy–looks a lot like you–showed up. Travelling with him, I thought, maybe ... you were still alive somewhere, ya? But, then again, here you are on the Farplane. Guess your place is here.', "So, how you been? Oh, that guy I just told you 'bout, I gave him your sword. He likes it.", 'Just a sec more.', 'Well? Need some more time?', 'Wha ... what was that just now? That really Lord Jyscal?', 'For a while there, I was a little worried about what was gonna happen, ya?', 'Macalania Temple.', "What I don't get is ... Why would the lord maester head off without a peep to anyone?", "Ah, that's probably it.", 'We head north, not too near and not too far from the towers, ya?', "Yes ma'am ...", "Hmm? What's wrong?", 'Uh, Yuna?', "I wonder what's wrong with Yuna ... No point asking–mood she's in.", "What do you think you're up to?", "Yeah, yeah! She'll tell us when she's ready, so hold your chocobos till then, ya?", "Whatever happens, we're still Yuna's guardians.", "Then let's just go on with the journey, ya?", 'I know how you feel.', "What's up?", "B-But why? Why'd you change your mind?", "You're kidding, ya?", "Yuna, just one question. Can't you just talk to Maester Seymour? You've got to marry him?", 'Okay, I guess.', "What's up?", "What's up?", "What's that?", "Whoa, this is old! Don't know if you can play it back.", "Seriously ... A wedding's not supposed to make people feel this bad, huh?", 'Hmph! I say whatever I want, ever since I was a kid!', 'You know it!', 'Anyways ... How long we supposed to stay here, you think?', "Things've sure gotten complicated since Sir Auron joined us.", "Still can't figure that guy out.", 'Al Bhed!', 'Lu! Cast your spells now!', 'Stupid machina! They sealed their magic away, too.', 'How come you speak Al Bhed? Why?', '(To others) You knew?', "Why didn't you tell me?", "This is great. You bad-mouth Yevon and that's all you can come up with?", 'Nothing has to change!', 'Sin will be gone once we atone for our past mistakes!', "If we keep faith in Yevon's teachings it will be gone one day!", "We're not using that, are we? Wait ... Sir Auron isn't an Al Bhed too, is he?", 'What?', "That's different. I mean ...", 'Lu?', "Where you goin'?", "But he's a maester!", "(Facepalm) This can't be happening.", "This can't be happening.", '(Pleading) Maester Seymour!', 'Maester! How can you all act like nothing's wrong? Must got nerves of steel or something.", 'Say, you feel something weird in the air? Some kind of bad vibes or something.', 'I thought so.', "Oh? Maybe I'm coming down with something.", 'I feel really weird.', "There's something here!", "Mm-hm. Where's Yuna?", "Dammit! (Kicks metal support) First I lose Yuna, then I'm ambushed by machina! (Hugs her) Damn those Guado! Let's do this!", "Better get ready. Ain't no shops where we're goin'.", 'You hit your head?', "Uh ... 'Bout your old man ... Why'd all this have to happen?", 'Wh-What are those?', "What's gotten into you? Hey!", 'Looks like we got a job to do, ya?', 'Right!', "Hey, come on, let's go.", "We've come a long way.", "Huh, never would've figured. Legendary guardians choke sometimes, too, ya?", 'Looks like the Farplane.', "Hey, wasn't that ... ?", 'Gone!?', 'But how? What, you got a plan now?', 'Me too, Yuna!', "Listen ... You wanna defeat Sin and keep Yuna alive ... You don't want Sin to come back, ya? That is just not gonna happen, brudda, you know?", "Now you're being childish!", "Neverending? But ... but ... if we atone for our crimes, Sin will stop coming back, ya? Someday, it'll be gone, ya?", 'Uh ...', "I can't believe we're gonna fight Lady Yunalesca! Gimme a break!", "Hah! I'd never forgive myself–no way! Not if I ran away now. Even in death, ya!", 'So much for the Final Aeon solving everything.', 'Hey, guys! I just had a great idea!', "(Shoves in front of her) It's like this, ya?", "Uh ... I know it's your old man, and I don't mean no disrespect, but ...", "Yeah, and that's when we make our move! Might be against the rules and all, but who's keeping track, ya? Ya?", "I got a good feeling 'bout this!", 'Oh, the traitor Omega, ya?', 'They say he liked it underground, out of the light.', "You're kidding me!", "What, so the main man's still around?", 'Whassup? Something here?', "(Facepalm) Man, don't these guys ever give up?", 'Bah! Disappear on us, will ya? Rotten son of a shoopuf!', 'Who you talking to?', 'Everyone in Spira!', "There's something I want to say before the fight. (Turns to Cid) I ... uh ... Hard to imagine, ya?", 'I hope everyone got the message.', 'How we gonna get inside?', "Hey, guys? Guys? That's not good, ya?", 'Go, go, go!', 'The Crusaders would be out of a job if it was this easy, ya?', 'Man, we must have hit that thing enough by now!', "Time to show them what we're made of, ya?", 'Now! And to think, if you hadn't come floating out of the sea that day.", 'Huh?', 'Hey!', 'Oh, the traitor Omega, ya?', 'They say he liked it underground, out of the light.', "You're kidding me!", "What, so the main man's still around?", 'Whassup? Something here?']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Been a while, sis. It\'s been seven years, but you still look the same. Geez, I\'m older than you, now! I guess it makes sense. Hey, I ... I brought you something! Check this out! Uh ... Eh ... \'ere we are! (Fishes sphere out of pocket) See? She looks just like you! Her name\'s "Yuna." Boy was I surprised the first time I saw her! Ah, \'course she\'s not as good as you. If you were still alive, I bet you\'d fight just like her. It\'s okay. Yuna will beat Sin for you, I know it. So, don\'t you worry. Okay, sis? See you.', 'Greetings, Lady Yuna. My name is Wantz.', "I have to carry on my brother's business. You've met him, I think. O'aka XXIII, merchant extraordinaire?", 'Mm. (Nods) My brother wanted to come help Lady Yuna. But the temple imprisoned him for helping traitors.', "Welcome to Oa'aka's.", "He's doing the same for you, Lady Yuna.", "Welcome! We've got some goodies today!"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['We are sorry, but not even blitzball players are allowed to pass.', "I'm right by the stadium, but I can't watch the game. What a bummer ...", "Did you forget something inside? Give it up. I doubt you'll find it.", 'It took forever to fix the stands inside the stadium.', "Even now that the tournament's over, the stadium is always jam-packed. That's Luca for you.", 'Most of the warrior monks have withdrawn to Bevelle, but some have taken a liking to Luca and remained here.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["Oh! (Comes over to embrace Auron) I'd heard from Seymour, but I didn't know if we'd actually meet. Good to see you, Auron! Ten years, is it?", '(Casual salute) Good. Dismissed.', 'Tell me, Auron. Where have you been the last ten years?', "This plan won't work, you know that. We'll just let them dream a little longer.", 'Oh, yes. Proceed.', 'I heard that, Auron. A lot has happened the last ten years. What were you doing, and where?', 'Just tell me one thing Have you seen Zanarkand?', 'Being a maester has its privileges. I can just sit here and watch.', 'What do you mean?', 'Hmm. The past ten years have changed you, I see.', "I know I don't need to tell you this, but guard Lord Braska well.", '(sigh) You know that promotion was meant for you. You were always the better one, even until the end.', 'Yes.', 'Going already?', "You will tell me about Zanarkand when you return, won't you?", "I know I don't need to tell you this, but guard Lord Braska well.", '(sigh) You know that promotion was meant for you. You were always the better one, even until the end.', 'Yes.', 'Going already?', "You will tell me about Zanarkand when you return, won't you?"]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['(shove) Why not talk, Kimahri? Not see Yenke for ten years! Say something! Kimahri forget Yenke? Forget Biran?', '(Guffaws) Kimahri forget Ronso friends? We taught you much at time of horn-molt! Biran taught Kimahri to be strong Ronso.', 'Hornless! Hornless!', 'Summoners disappear. Never return.', 'Poor Kimahri! Lost his horn, next lose his summoner!', 'Blasphemers!', 'No escape! Not one!', 'Forget his people, forget his mountain. Little Ronso! Weakling Ronso!', 'Kimahri never beat brother Biran! Never win!', 'Hornless! Hornless!', 'Not good enough, Kimahri.', 'Weak Ronso should know their place.', 'You will pay for this!', 'You ... win.', 'Mountain knows Kimahri strong. Kimahri may pass.', 'We crush enemies following behind.', 'Ronso will shine your statue brightest.', 'With grand horn on head!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['People of Spira, I thank you for your generous welcome. Rise, Maester Seymour. And all of you as well. I present to you ... the son of Maester Jyscal Guado, who departed for the Farplane a fortnight past.', 'As some of you already know, he has been officially ordained a maester of Yevon.', 'Today, on this glorious day, players from all over Spira have assembled here ... to participate in this great contest of bravery, skill, and strength.', 'All of these fine teams, equally renowned, deserve to win the cup today. Such is the nature of this contest. Let us, the spectators, play our role accordingly Let us sing to the glory of the winners, and applaud equally the valor of the defeated.', 'Contestants, may Yevon be with you.', 'Why are you here? You must go and defeat Sin, quickly! You have obtained the Final Aeon from Yunalesca, have you not?', 'What!', "You have profaned and subverted a thousand-year-old tradition? Fools! Infants! Do you realize what you've done? You've taken away the only means of calming Sin!", 'Why ... Preposterous! There is no other way!', "Spira has lost its only hope. Destruction is inevitable. Yu Yevon's spiral of death will consume us all. I have no desire to watch Spira die."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["The elders just won't give up the old tongue. I keep telling them how unseemly it is, babbling like that to guests.", "It's just what old folks do, I guess. Please, take no offense.", "Some say that it was the Guado who threw Spira into chaos. It pains me to admit it, but they're right.", "Luca has informed us that the Guado team may continue to compete in tournaments. We were saved by the Lucans' generosity.", 'I want to return the favor by giving them a performance to remember.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I've done it. I have become a summoner!", 'Okay.', 'But it was really my fault to begin with.', "I'm Yuna. Thank you so much for your help earlier.", 'Oh, no. Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Welcome to Zanarkand. I congratulate you, summoner. You have completed your pilgrimage. I will now bestow you with that which you seek. The Final Summoning ... will be yours. Now, choose.', 'You must choose the one whom I will change ... to become the fayth of the Final Summoning.', 'There must be a bond, between chosen and summoner, for that is what the Final Summoning embodies the bond between husband and wife, mother and child, or between friends. If that bond is strong enough, its light will conquer Sin. A thousand years ago, I chose my husband Zaon as my fayth. Our bond was true, and I obtained the Final Aeon. There is nothing to fear. You will soon be freed of worry and pain. For once you call forth the Final Aeon, your life will end. Death is the ultimate and final liberation. Your father, Braska, chose this path.', 'Have you chosen the one to become your fayth? Who will it be?', 'Sin is eternal. Every aeon that defeats it becomes Sin in its place ... And thus is Sin reborn.', "Sin is an inevitable part of Spira's destiny. It is neverending.", 'Will humanity ever attain such purity?', 'Hope is ... comforting. It allows us to accept fate, however tragic it might be.', 'They chose to die ... because they had hope.', "Yevon's teachings and the Final Summoning give the people of Spira hope. Without hope, they would drown in their sorrow. Now, choose. Who will be your fayth? Who will be the one to renew Spira's hope?", 'No. It is our only hope. Your father sacrificed himself to give that hope to the people. So they would forget sorrow.', 'Sorrow cannot be abolished. It is meaningless to try.', 'Poor creature. You would throw away hope. Well ... I will free you before you can drown in your sorrow. It is better for you to die in hope than to live in despair. Let me be your liberator.', "If I die, so does the Final Aeon. And with it, Spira's only hope.", 'Fool. There is no other way. Even if there was ... Even if you did destroy Sin ... Yu Yevon the immortal would only create Sin anew.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I gave up the seafaring life. I've had enough of storms and shipwrecks.", "Sin attacks unexpectedly. I'm through with life at sea.", "I quit the sailor's life because I'm terrified of Sin. I'm too ashamed to face my shipmates."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Ronso are strong, but winning takes more than strength.', 'When warrior monks protect stadium, fiends have no chance of breaking in.', 'No longer can temple help us. Must protect Spira on our own.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['I was in a coffee shop, running away from home when I heard the news. Our hero, Jecht, gone. Vanished into thin air! My dad must have been his biggest fan. I knew how sad he\'d be. Heck, we all were that day. "Zanar," I says to myself, "What are you thinking?" I went running straight back home. We sat up talking \'bout Jecht all night. My dad and I never talked so much. Whoa ... Didn\'t mean to reminisce, folks. Anyway ... Ten years later, the Jecht Memorial Cup tournament is today! The two teams that have won through to the finals are ... of course, the Abes from A-East, and the Duggles from C-South. I know there\'s a lot of people out there today to see the star of the Abes! In just one year, he\'s become the team\'s number one player! He\'s Jecht\'s blood, and the new hope of blitzball! What kind of super play will he show us today? Will we see his father\'s legendary shot? I don\'t think I\'m the only one excited here, folks!']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ["I'd love to step away from the Guado glories and play for a different team once in a while. Why, if they paid me enough, I'd even play for the Al Bhed!", "We're always practicing out in the Moonflow. But the other day a shoopuf passed by and nearly flattened us! We also test our reflexes by dodging lighting bolts on the Thunder Plains.", "It's true that many tossed themselves to the Farplane in Lord Seymour's name. But until recently, I looked up to him so much. So I suppose I'd be a hypocrite to belittle him. I might come across as proud, but pride is all I have left."]

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Luca too hot for Ronso.', 'Al Bhed ship leave Luca. No one knows where they go.', 'Warrior monks run away to Bevelle. They abandon the people. Should hide their faces in shame.']

Title: Final Fantasy X
Dialogues: ['Long time no see.', "You are Yuna? Hmm ... You certainly don't look like Maester Kinoc's murderer.", 'Maester Mika just issued a personal order, you know. It said that you and your guardians murdered Maester Kinoc and fled. We are to kill you on sight, or so it says.', 'Things are calm on the surface, but the depths are turbulent. After the death of Maester Kinoc, Kelk Ronso left Yevon.', 'But be careful, my friends. You have been branded enemies of Yevon. You should avoid temples for the time being.', 'To tell the truth, I was a little curious to see ... this summoner you are guarding. I hope her pilgrimage goes well. For your sake, too.']
